senses.why: Living invaders follow the same pattern as chemicals: they enter, establish and change the system.
senses.whyCN: 活的入侵者与化学品走同一条路径：进入、立足、改变系统。

senses.title: A substance on a regulatory list
senses.titleCN: 被列入管制清单的物质
senses.definition: a named substance whose concentration in a medium is limited by law or permit
senses.definitionCN: 在法律或许可中被限定于某一介质内浓度的具名物质
senses.example: The permit listed each pollutant and its allowed load.
senses.exampleCN: 许可证列出了每种污染物及其允许排放量。
senses.why: Regulation turns the concept into a list, so pollutant comes to mean a substance that has a legal threshold.
senses.whyCN: 监管把这个概念变成一份清单，pollutant 于是指「有法定阈值的物质」。

senses.title: Abstract: an idea that degrades a field
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：使某个领域变质的东西
senses.definition: a transferred use for information, speech or data that corrupts the quality of a discussion or system
senses.definitionCN: 转指使讨论或系统质量变质的信息、言论或数据
senses.example: Fabricated studies are a pollutant in the literature.
senses.exampleCN: 伪造的研究是文献中的一种污染。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the environmental shape: something enters, spreads and makes the whole medium less fit for use.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了环境形态：某物进入、扩散，使整个介质的可用性下降。

intro.en: Pollutant is formed in English from pollute plus the agent suffix -ant. The verb itself goes back through French to Latin polluere, whose internal history is only partly explained. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: pollutant 在英语中由 pollute 加施动后缀 -ant 构成。动词本身经法语可追到拉丁 polluere，其内部构造只得到部分解释。年代均为约数。

items.en: One element of polluere is usually identified as luere 'to wash, to purify'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; the Indo-European root proposed for it is a reconstruction, and the connection with lavare 'to wash' is treated as a related form rather than a proved parent.
items.cn: polluere 的一个成分通常被认作 luere「洗、净化」。其更深来源不确定；为它提出的印欧词根是重构，与 lavare「洗」的联系被当作相关形式，而非已证实的母词。

items.en: The verb is analysed as por- (a variant of pro- 'forth') plus luere, but how a washing root produced the sense 'to defile' is not fully explained, and some accounts treat the prefix as merely intensive rather than locative.
items.cn: 这个动词通常被分析为 por-（pro-「向前」的变体）加 luere，但「洗」的词根如何产生「弄脏」之义并未得到完整解释，也有说法把该前缀视为单纯的加强成分而非方位成分。

items.en: Late Latin pollutio named defilement, especially ritual or moral uncleanness, and this religious sense came into English first.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 pollutio 指玷污，尤指仪式或道德上的不洁，这一宗教义最先进入英语。

items.en: English pollute appears in the fourteenth century with the sense of desecrating something sacred; the physical sense of dirtying air or water is much later.
items.cn: 英语 pollute 在十四世纪出现，指亵渎神圣之物；弄脏空气或水的物理义要晚得多。

items.en: From the nineteenth century pollution was applied to smoke, sewage and industrial waste, and pollutant was coined as the countable name for one offending substance.
items.cn: 从十九世纪起，pollution 被用于烟、污水与工业废料，pollutant 则作为「一种肇事物质」的可数名称被造出。

items.en: Source uncertain (internal history of polluere and first date of pollutant): the shift from washing to defiling is unexplained, and the noun's earliest technical citation is not fixed, so its date is approximate; any older form offered for luere is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（polluere 的内部构造与 pollutant 的首见年代）：从「洗」到「弄脏」的转变未获解释，这个名词最早的技术书证也无定论，年代只能约计；凡为 luere 给出的更早形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same pollute family plus one look-alike with an unrelated root; group two holds other words for harmful inputs, each with a different kind of harm.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 pollute 词族的各种形式，外加一个词根无关的形近词；第二组是其他表示「有害输入」的词，各自的危害方式不同。

entries.definition: The presence or accumulation of pollutants; it names the condition, while pollutant names one substance.
entries.definitionCN: 污染物的存在或累积；它指状态，而 pollutant 指一种物质。

entries.definition: The person or firm that pollutes; it names an actor, not the substance released.
entries.definitionCN: 造成污染的人或企业；它指施动者，而非排放的物质。

entries.definition: To make air, water or soil dirty or harmful; it is the action that produces a pollutant.
entries.definitionCN: 使空气、水或土壤变脏或有害；它是产生污染物的动作。

entries.definition: A head, a survey of votes or a hornless animal, from Middle English polle 'head'; it looks like the poll- of pollute but is unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 指头、投票调查或无角动物，出自中古英语 polle「头」；它形似 pollute 的 poll-，但并无亲缘。

entries.definition: A substance that makes something impure; it may unfits a product without harming an ecosystem.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物不纯的物质；它可能使产品不合格，却未必危害生态。

entries.definition: A poisonous substance; it is defined by toxicity, while a pollutant is defined by environmental harm.
entries.definitionCN: 有毒物质；它以毒性定义，而污染物以环境危害定义。

entries.definition: The act or quantity of something released into the air; it names the outflow, not the substance's harm.
entries.definitionCN: 释放入空气的动作或数量；它指排出流，而非物质的危害性。

entries.definition: Treated or untreated liquid waste flowing out of a plant; it may contain pollutants but is named by its flow.
entries.definitionCN: 从厂区流出的处理过或未处理的废液；它可能含污染物，但以「流」命名。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Pollutant is pollute plus -ant, the suffix that marks the doer: the substance that does the polluting.
normal.cn: pollutant 是 pollute 加 -ant，这个后缀标出施动者：执行污染的那个物质。

normal.en: The family runs pollute, pollution, polluter, polluted and polluting.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 pollute、pollution、polluter、polluted 与 polluting。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the medium: air pollutant, water pollutant, soil pollutant.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出介质：空气污染物、水体污染物、土壤污染物。

normal.en: Regulation turns it into a list: each pollutant has a permitted level or load.
normal.cn: 监管把它变成清单：每种污染物都有允许的浓度或排放量。

normal.en: Poll looks like the same root but means 'head', from Middle English polle.
normal.cn: poll 看似同根，实指「头」，出自中古英语 polle。

abstract.en: Picture smoke entering a valley and staying there because the walls block the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象烟进入一个山谷，因为山壁挡风而留在里面。

abstract.en: Picture one bad number travelling through a chain of reports.
abstract.cn: 想象一个坏数字在一串报告里传下去。

abstract.en: Picture a loud generator that harms nothing you can see but spoils the whole street.
abstract.cn: 想象一台吵闹的发电机，看不见任何损伤，却毁了整条街。

examples.en: The plant must report every pollutant it releases.
examples.cn: 该厂必须报告它排放的每一种污染物。

examples.en: A pollutant may travel hundreds of kilometres before it settles.
examples.cn: 一种污染物可能飘行数百公里才沉降。

examples.en: Noise is treated as a pollutant in the city's zoning code.
examples.cn: 在这座城市的区划法规中，噪声被当作一种污染。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pollute（污染）+ ant」——出面把环境弄脏的那一个 → 污染物

root: pollute 加 -ant；pollute 经法语出自拉丁 polluere「弄脏、玷污」，通常分析为 por-（pro- 变体）+ luere「洗」，但由「洗」到「弄脏」的转变未获完整解释，luere 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one entry: a substance enters a medium, harms life or use, is listed and limited, may persist, and may even be energy or an idea rather than matter.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次进入展开：物质进入某种介质，危害生命或用途，被列入清单并受限额，可能长期留存，甚至可以是能量或一个想法而非物质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grey plume leaving a stack and sinking onto a row of roofs.
core.cn: 核心意象：一股灰烟离开烟囱，压到一排屋顶上。

branches.en: MEDIA: the general definition and the air, water and soil cases differ only in where the substance lands.
branches.cn: 介质：总定义与空气、水、土壤三种情形，区别只在物质落在哪里。

branches.en: ENERGY AS POLLUTANT: noise, light and heat harm by excess rather than by matter.
branches.cn: 能量作污染：噪声、光与热靠过量而非物质造成危害。

branches.en: LIFE AS POLLUTANT: an organism can invade and change a system like a chemical.
branches.cn: 生命作污染：生物也能像化学品一样侵入并改变系统。

branches.en: LAW: a named substance with a threshold is what regulation means by pollutant.
branches.cn: 法律：有名字、有阈值的物质，就是监管所说的污染物。

branches.en: TRANSFER: bad ideas and bad data pollute a medium of thought.
branches.cn: 转移：坏想法与坏数据污染思想的介质。

intro.en: Pollutant is an English derivative of a Latin verb; the suffix is clear, while the internal analysis of the Latin verb is only partly settled.
intro.cn: pollutant 是拉丁动词的英语派生词；后缀清楚，而拉丁动词的内部构造只部分确定。

latinIntro.en: Latin polluere gives pollute, pollution and pollutant; the suffix -ant also forms contaminant, toxicant and coolant.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 polluere 衍生 pollute、pollution 与 pollutant；后缀 -ant 也构成 contaminant、toxicant 与 coolant。

items.example: The verb named ritual and physical defilement alike.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词兼指仪式与物理上的玷污。

items.example: The washing element is the disputed half of polluere.
items.exampleCN: 「洗」这个成分是 polluere 中有争议的一半。

items.example: The suffix marks the substance as the doer.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把该物质标为施动者。

items.example: The mill polluted the river for decades.
items.exampleCN: 这家厂污染河流数十年。

items.example: Air pollution closed the schools.
items.exampleCN: 空气污染使学校停课。

items.example: The list named twelve pollutants.
items.exampleCN: 清单列出了十二种污染物。

items.example: The polluter paid for the cleanup.
items.exampleCN: 污染者支付了清理费用。

items.example: The polluted canal was fenced off.
items.exampleCN: 受污染的运河被围了起来。

items.example: The most polluting cars were banned.
items.exampleCN: 污染最重的汽车被禁行。

items.example: They advertised a pollutant-free process.
items.exampleCN: 他们宣传一种无污染工艺。

definition_zh: 污染；污染状态；有害物质或能量进入环境并造成损害
definition_en: the introduction of harmful substances or energy into the environment, or the state of being damaged by them
core_image: 河湾水面浮着一层彩色油光，岸边芦苇被塑料绳缠住，清水已成危险之物
scene: 河湾的水面漂着一层彩色油光，岸边芦苇被塑料绳缠住。Pollution had turned the once clear river into a hazard.
sceneCN: 这里 pollution 指「水体受到有害物质侵入而变坏的状态」（第 4 个义项：水污染使水体失去原有用途）；句意为污染把曾经清澈的河变成了危险之地。图中可辨识物件：河湾、油光水膜、塑料绳、芦苇。

pos.zh: 污染；污染状态（不可数为主，复数指多种或多次污染）

senses.title: Harmful matter or energy entering the environment
senses.titleCN: 有害物质或能量进入环境
senses.definition: the act of putting harmful substances or excess energy into air, water or soil
senses.definitionCN: 把有害物质或过量能量放入空气、水体或土壤的行为
senses.example: Pollution had turned the once clear river into a hazard.
senses.exampleCN: 污染把曾经清澈的河变成了危险之地。
senses.why: The word names the act before it names the result: something is put into a medium that was not there before.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先命名动作，再命名结果：某物被放进了本来没有它的介质里。

senses.title: The damaged state of a medium
senses.titleCN: 介质受损害的状态
senses.definition: the condition of air, water or land after harmful matter has entered it
senses.definitionCN: 空气、水或土地在有害物质进入之后所处的状态
senses.example: The lake's pollution was visible as a green scum.
senses.exampleCN: 湖水的污染表现为一层绿色浮沫。
senses.why: English uses the same noun for the act and its result, so pollution can be what was done and what is now there.
senses.whyCN: 英语用同一个名词兼指动作与结果，因此 pollution 既可以是「做了什么」，也可以是「现在有什么」。

senses.title: Air pollution
senses.titleCN: 空气污染
senses.definition: the presence of smoke, gases or particles in the air at harmful concentrations
senses.definitionCN: 烟、气体或颗粒以有害浓度存在于空气中
senses.example: Winter air pollution settles over the plain and hides the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季的空气污染压在平原上，把群山遮住。
senses.why: Coal smoke made this sense the first and most visible kind of pollution in industrial cities.
senses.whyCN: 煤烟使这个义项成为工业城市里最早、最可见的一种污染。

senses.title: Water pollution
senses.titleCN: 水污染
senses.definition: the entry of sewage, chemicals or waste into rivers, lakes, groundwater or the sea
senses.definitionCN: 污水、化学品或废物进入河流、湖泊、地下水或海洋
senses.example: Water pollution from the tannery reached the wells downstream.
senses.exampleCN: 制革厂造成的水污染波及下游的水井。
senses.why: Water carries harm away from the source, so the word stresses the medium that spreads it.
senses.whyCN: 水把危害从源头带走，这个词于是强调传播它的介质。

senses.title: Soil and land pollution
senses.titleCN: 土壤与土地污染
senses.definition: the accumulation of harmful substances in soil, or the degradation of land by waste
senses.definitionCN: 有害物质在土壤中累积，或土地因废物而退化
senses.example: Soil pollution kept the allotments out of use for years.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤污染让这些菜地多年不能使用。
senses.why: Soil holds what air and water deliver, so pollution here is a deposit that stays in place.
senses.whyCN: 土壤承接空气与水送来的东西，这里的污染是留在原地的沉积。

senses.title: Noise, light and heat pollution
senses.titleCN: 噪声、光与热污染
senses.definition: excess energy that harms health, wildlife or the quality of a place without adding substance
senses.definitionCN: 过量的能量，不添加物质却危害健康、野生生物或环境品质
senses.example: Light pollution erased the stars above the coastal towns.
senses.exampleCN: 光污染抹去了沿海城镇上空的星空。
senses.why: Modern regulation widened the word to energy, because harm does not require a material to be present.
senses.whyCN: 现代监管把这个词扩展到能量，因为造成危害并不需要有物质在场。

senses.title: Plastic and marine pollution
senses.titleCN: 塑料与海洋污染
senses.definition: the accumulation of persistent waste, especially plastics, in oceans and on shores
senses.definitionCN: 持久性废物、尤其是塑料，在海洋与海岸上的累积
senses.example: Marine pollution washed ashore as bottle caps and netting.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋污染以瓶盖和网绳的形式冲上岸。
senses.why: A single material became so dominant that it earned its own use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 单一材料变得如此突出，以至于单独占用了这个词的一种用法。

senses.title: Ritual or moral defilement
senses.titleCN: 仪式或道德上的玷污
senses.definition: the historical sense of making something sacred or pure unclean
senses.definitionCN: 使神圣或纯洁之物变得不洁的旧义
senses.example: The old texts speak of pollution that required a rite of cleansing.
senses.exampleCN: 古籍中说到需要行洁净礼才能解除的玷污。
senses.why: The word entered English as a religious term, and the environmental sense is a later branch of the same image.
senses.whyCN: 这个词以宗教术语进入英语，环境义是同一意象后来分出的枝。

senses.title: Abstract: degradation of information or discourse
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：信息与言论环境的变质
senses.definition: a transferred use for the flooding of a field with false, low-quality or manipulative content
senses.definitionCN: 转指某领域被虚假、低质或操纵性内容淹没
senses.example: Information pollution makes a reliable source harder to find.
senses.exampleCN: 信息污染使可靠来源更难找到。
senses.why: The metaphor preserves the structure: a shared medium is filled with something that lowers its value for everyone.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了结构：共用的介质被填入某物，使它对所有人都贬值。

intro.en: Pollution came to English through French from Latin pollutio, a noun of defilement. Its oldest English sense is religious; the environmental sense is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: pollution 经法语来自拉丁 pollutio，是一个表示「玷污」的名词。它最早的英语义项是宗教性的，环境义则是近代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: The verb behind the noun is usually divided into por- (a form of pro- 'forth') and luere 'to wash'. The deeper origin of luere is uncertain, and the relation sometimes drawn to lavare 'to wash' is a related-form hypothesis, not a proved descent.
items.cn: 这个名词背后的动词通常拆成 por-（pro-「向前」的一种形式）与 luere「洗」。luere 的更深来源不确定，有人把它与 lavare「洗」联系，那只是「相关形式」的假说，并非已证实的承继。

items.en: Polluere meant 'to defile, to corrupt'. How the washing element came to mean defiling is not fully explained; one account treats the prefix as intensive rather than directional.
items.cn: polluere 意为「弄脏、败坏」。「洗」的成分如何转为「弄脏」，并未得到完整解释；一种说法把前缀视为加强成分而非方向成分。

items.en: Late Latin pollutio named a defiling, especially ritual uncleanness, and this is the sense that entered English.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 pollutio 指玷污，尤指仪式上的不洁，进入英语的正是这一义项。

items.en: From the fourteenth century English pollution meant the desecration of sacred things or the state of being ritually unclean.
items.cn: 从十四世纪起，英语 pollution 指对神圣之物的亵渎或仪式上的不洁状态。

items.en: In the nineteenth century smoke, sewage and factory waste gave the word its modern environmental sense, and it soon became a public-health issue.
items.cn: 十九世纪，烟、污水与工厂废料赋予这个词现代环境义，它很快成为公共卫生议题。

items.en: Source uncertain (internal history of polluere, first date of the environmental sense): the semantic path from washing to defiling is unexplained and the first environmental citation is not fixed, so its date is approximate; any older form offered for luere is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（polluere 的内部构造、环境义的首见年代）：从「洗」到「弄脏」的语义路径未获解释，环境义的最早书证也无定论，年代只能约计；凡为 luere 给出的更早形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same pollute stock that differ in grammar or role; group two holds other words for environmental damage, each naming a different part of the problem.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 pollute 词干、语法角色不同的形式；第二组是其他表示环境损害的词，各自命名问题的一个不同部分。

entries.definition: A single offending substance; pollution is the resulting condition or the whole accumulation.
entries.definitionCN: 一种肇事的物质；pollution 是造成的结果或整体累积。

entries.definition: To put harmful matter into a medium; the noun names what the verb produces.
entries.definitionCN: 把有害物质放入介质；名词指动词所产生的状态。

entries.definition: A person or firm that pollutes; it is a responsible party, not a condition.
entries.definitionCN: 造成污染的人或企业；它是责任方，而非状态。

entries.definition: A head, a vote survey or a hornless beast, from Middle English polle; the resemblance to pollute is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 指头、投票调查或无角牲畜，出自中古英语 polle；与 pollute 的相似只是偶然。

entries.definition: The making impure of a substance or product; it need not harm an ecosystem, which pollution implies.
entries.definitionCN: 使物质或产品不纯；它未必危害生态，而 pollution 含有这一层。

entries.definition: A general lowering of quality or condition; pollution is one cause of environmental degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 品质或状况的普遍下降；污染是环境退化的一个原因。

entries.definition: The release of a substance into the air; pollution is the harm that follows from such releases.
entries.definitionCN: 物质向空气的排放；pollution 是这类排放带来的危害。

entries.definition: The clogging or dirtying of equipment, hulls or beds; it is a practical nuisance sense, not a public-health one.
entries.definitionCN: 设备、船体或床层的堵塞与污损；它是设备层面的麻烦义，而非公共卫生义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Pollution is the noun of pollute: the act of putting harm into a medium and the state that follows.
normal.cn: pollution 是 pollute 的名词：把危害放入介质的动作，以及随之而来的状态。

normal.en: The family runs pollute, pollutant, polluter, polluted and polluting.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 pollute、pollutant、polluter、polluted 与 polluting。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the medium: air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, noise pollution.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出介质：空气污染、水污染、土壤污染、噪声污染。

normal.en: The oldest English sense was religious: pollution meant ritual uncleanness before it meant smoke.
normal.cn: 最早的英语义项是宗教性的：pollution 先指仪式上的不洁，后指烟尘。

normal.en: Poll looks alike but means 'head', so it is a false relative.
normal.cn: poll 形似而同源无关，意为「头」，是假同源。

abstract.en: Picture a clear river receiving one pipe and losing its colour downstream.
abstract.cn: 想象一条清河接入一根管子，下游就失了颜色。

abstract.en: Picture a night sky erased by a ring of lamps.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈路灯抹掉了夜空。

abstract.en: Picture a library shelf filled with books that repeat nonsense.
abstract.cn: 想象书架上塞满反复讲胡话的书。

examples.en: Pollution in the estuary comes from farms far upstream.
examples.cn: 河口处的污染来自远在上游的农田。

examples.en: The city monitors pollution every hour at ten stations.
examples.cn: 该市在十个监测站每小时监测污染。

examples.en: Noise pollution from the highway reaches the school.
examples.cn: 公路的噪声污染传到了学校。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pollute（污染）+ ion」——把脏东西放进环境这件事，以及它造成的状态 → 污染

root: 拉丁 pollutio「玷污」< polluere「弄脏」；polluere 通常拆为 por-（pro- 变体）+ luere「洗」，但「洗」转为「弄脏」未获完整解释，luere 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one intrusion: a clean medium is entered, its state changes, each medium gets its own name, energy and waste join the list, and the old religious image survives at one end while the metaphor of a spoiled shared medium survives at the other.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一次侵入展开：洁净介质被进入，状态改变，各介质各得一名，能量与废物加入清单，一端留着旧的宗教意象，另一端留着「共用介质被弄坏」的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an oily sheen on a river bend, with reeds tangled in plastic cord.
core.cn: 核心意象：河湾上一层油光，芦苇缠着塑料绳。

branches.en: ACT AND STATE: English uses one noun for the putting-in and for what is left afterwards.
branches.cn: 动作与状态：英语用同一个名词兼指「放入」与「放入后剩下的」。

branches.en: THREE MEDIA: air, water and soil each make pollution visible in a different way.
branches.cn: 三种介质：空气、水与土壤各以不同方式让污染显形。

branches.en: ADDED ENERGY AND WASTE: noise, light and plastic all fit the same frame of something extra.
branches.cn: 能量与废物：噪声、光与塑料都落在「多出来的东西」这同一框架里。

branches.en: OLD ROOT: ritual defilement is the image from which the environmental sense grew.
branches.cn: 旧根：仪式上的玷污是环境义从中长出的意象。

branches.en: NEW ROOT: information pollution repeats the image in a shared medium of thought.
branches.cn: 新枝：信息污染在同一意象上重复，只是介质成了共用的思想空间。

intro.en: Pollution is a Latin noun of action with a debated root, so the suffix and prefix are clear while the semantic history of the root is not.
intro.cn: pollution 是拉丁动作名词，词根有争议，因此前缀与后缀清楚，而词根的语义历史不清楚。

latinIntro.en: Latin polluere gives pollute, pollution, pollutant and polluter; -io, -ionis forms nouns of action in English -ion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 polluere 衍生 pollute、pollution、pollutant 与 polluter；-io, -ionis 在英语中构成 -ion 动作名词。

items.example: One account reads the prefix as directional.
items.exampleCN: 一种说法把这个前缀读作方向性的。

items.example: The washing element is the disputed half of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 「洗」这个成分是动词中有争议的一半。

items.example: Polluere named both ritual and physical uncleanness.
items.exampleCN: polluere 兼指仪式与物理上的不洁。

items.example: The suffix turns the verb into a noun of action.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成动作名词。

items.meaning: a defiling; the state of being defiled
items.example: Pollution closed the beach.
items.exampleCN: 污染使海滩关闭。

items.example: The plant polluted the creek.
items.exampleCN: 工厂污染了小溪。

items.example: Each pollutant has a limit.
items.exampleCN: 每种污染物都有上限。

items.example: The polluter paid a fine.
items.exampleCN: 污染者缴纳了罚款。

items.example: The polluted stream ran black.
items.exampleCN: 受污染的小溪流着黑水。

items.example: Polluting fuels were taxed.
items.exampleCN: 造成污染的燃料被征税。

definition_zh: 污染控制；防治污染；为减少或限制污染物排放而采取的措施与制度
definition_en: the measures, equipment and rules used to prevent, limit or reduce the release of pollutants into the environment
core_image: 控制室屏幕上一条排放曲线被压回限值以下，操作员调低了投药阀
scene: 污水处理厂的中央控制室里，操作员盯着屏幕上跳动的排放曲线，把投药量调低了一格。Pollution control relies on constant measurement as much as on equipment.
sceneCN: 这里 pollution control 指「为把污染物排放压到限值以内所采取的措施与制度」（第 1 个义项：对污染排放进行监测、限制与削减的总体做法）；句意为污染控制既靠设备，也同样靠持续测量。图中可辨识物件：控制室、排放曲线、投药阀、限值线。

pos.zh: 污染控制；污染防治（不可数名词短语）

forms.label: 复数（具体的多项控制措施）

senses.title: Measures that keep pollution within limits
senses.titleCN: 把污染压在限度以内的措施
senses.definition: the whole set of actions by which harmful releases are measured, limited and reduced
senses.definitionCN: 对有害排放进行测量、限制与削减的一整套行动
senses.example: Pollution control relies on constant measurement as much as on equipment.
senses.exampleCN: 污染控制既靠设备，也同样靠持续测量。
senses.why: Control came from a counter-roll kept to check an account, so the phrase carries the idea of checking a release against a fixed figure.
senses.whyCN: control 出自用来核对账目的「对照卷」，因此这个短语带着「拿排放与一个固定数字核对」的意思。

senses.title: Air pollution control equipment
senses.titleCN: 空气污染控制设备
senses.definition: scrubbers, filters, cyclones and catalytic converters that remove pollutants from a gas stream
senses.definitionCN: 从气流中去除污染物的洗涤器、过滤器、旋风分离器与催化转化器
senses.example: The plant fitted a scrubber as its main air pollution control.
senses.exampleCN: 该厂安装洗涤器作为主要的空气污染控制手段。
senses.why: For a smokestack the control is a device at the end of the pipe, and this is the sense engineers use most.
senses.whyCN: 对烟囱而言，控制就是管末端的一台设备，这是工程师最常用的义项。

senses.title: Water pollution control by treatment
senses.titleCN: 以处理实现的水污染控制
senses.definition: sewage and industrial treatment that removes pollutants before discharge
senses.definitionCN: 在排放之前去除污染物的污水与工业废水处理
senses.example: Water pollution control begins at the outfall of the dye works.
senses.exampleCN: 水污染控制从染厂的排水口开始。
senses.why: In water the control point is the discharge pipe, so treatment plants are the practical form of the phrase.
senses.whyCN: 在水体上，控制点是排放管，因此处理厂就是这一短语的实体形式。

senses.title: A legal and regulatory regime
senses.titleCN: 法律与监管制度
senses.definition: standards, permits, inspections and enforcement that fix what may be released
senses.definitionCN: 规定可排放何种物质的标准、许可、检查与执法
senses.example: The agency's pollution control powers were strengthened last year.
senses.exampleCN: 该机构的污染控制权限去年得到加强。
senses.why: Once harm is public, control moves from the factory floor to the statute book.
senses.whyCN: 危害一旦涉及公众，控制就从车间移到法规文本。

senses.title: Economic instruments that price releases
senses.titleCN: 给排放定价的经济手段
senses.definition: taxes, fees, subsidies and tradable permits that make pollution costly
senses.definitionCN: 使污染变得昂贵的税费、补贴与可交易许可
senses.example: Tradable permits turned pollution control into a market.
senses.exampleCN: 可交易许可把污染控制变成了一个市场。
senses.why: Instead of ordering a limit, the regulator can attach a price to each unit released, and the control works through cost.
senses.whyCN: 监管者不必直接下令限值，而可以给每一单位排放挂上价格，让控制通过成本起作用。

senses.title: In-plant process control
senses.titleCN: 厂内工艺控制
senses.definition: changes to raw materials, temperature and process design that reduce waste at the source
senses.definitionCN: 通过改变原料、温度与工艺设计在源头减少废物的做法
senses.example: Process control cut the solvent waste before it reached the drain.
senses.exampleCN: 工艺控制在溶剂废料进排水管之前就把它削减了。
senses.why: The cheapest pollutant to control is the one never produced, so the phrase reaches back up the pipe.
senses.whyCN: 最省事的污染控制是根本不产生的污染，因此这个短语会向上游追溯到管道之前。

senses.title: Monitoring and enforcement
senses.titleCN: 监测与执法
senses.definition: sensors, sampling and inspection that check whether limits are actually met
senses.definitionCN: 用以核查限值是否真正达标的传感器、取样与检查
senses.example: Continuous monitoring made pollution control verifiable.
senses.exampleCN: 连续监测使污染控制变得可核查。
senses.why: A rule without a measurement is only a wish, and this sense names the apparatus that closes the loop.
senses.whyCN: 没有测量的规则只是愿望，这个义项就指闭合这一环的装置。

senses.title: Abstract: restraint on any harmful spillover
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：对任何有害外溢的约束
senses.definition: a transferred use for limits placed on side effects that one party imposes on others
senses.definitionCN: 转指对一方强加于他人的副作用所设的限制
senses.example: The committee called for noise pollution control around the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会呼吁对机场周边的噪声污染加以控制。
senses.why: The structure is general: an unwanted outflow, a boundary, and a rule that keeps the outflow inside it.
senses.whyCN: 结构是通用的：一股不受欢迎的外溢、一道边界，以及一条把外溢拦在界内的规则。

intro.en: Pollution control joins a Latin noun of defilement to a word that began as an accounting check. The phrase itself belongs to twentieth-century public policy. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: pollution control 把一个拉丁「玷污」名词连到一个原本指「账目核对」的词上。这个短语本身属于二十世纪公共政策。年代均为约数。

items.en: Pollutio meant 'a defiling'. Its base verb polluere is usually analysed as por- plus luere 'to wash', but how washing became defiling is not explained, so the root history is uncertain.
items.cn: pollutio 意为「玷污」。其基础动词 polluere 通常分析为 por- 加 luere「洗」，但「洗」如何变成「弄脏」未获解释，因此词根历史存疑。

items.en: Rotulus was a little roll, a diminutive of rota 'wheel'. The deeper origin of rota is not established; the root often proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: rotulus 指小卷，是 rota「轮」的指小形式。rota 的更深来源未得到证明；常为它提出的词根属重构。

items.en: Contra- 'against' plus rotulus produced contrarotulus, a counter-roll kept beside an original so that the two could be checked against each other.
items.cn: contra-「对照」加 rotulus 构成 contrarotulus，即与正本并存的对照卷，用来彼此核对。

items.en: Anglo-French contreroller meant 'to check against a roll'. English control kept the idea of checking, then widened to authority and regulation.
items.cn: 英法语的 contreroller 意为「对照卷册核对」。英语 control 保留了「核对」之意，随后扩展到「权限」与「管制」。

items.en: Pollution and control were joined in public-health and engineering writing once smoke and sewage had to be limited by rule as well as by device.
items.cn: 当烟尘与污水既要靠设备、也要靠规则来限制时，pollution 与 control 在公共卫生与工程写作中连用。

items.en: Source uncertain (root of pollution, deeper origin of rota, first date of the compound): the washing-to-defiling shift is unexplained, the pre-Latin origin of rota is unsettled, and the phrase has no fixed earliest citation, so its first date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（pollution 的词根、rota 的更深来源、该短语的首见年代）：由「洗」到「弄脏」的转变未获解释，rota 在拉丁语之前的来源无定论，这个短语也没有固定的最早书证，首见年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds control compounds that share the second word but govern a different object; group two holds environmental terms that overlap with this one at different points in the chain.
note.cn: 第一组是同含 control、但管治对象不同的复合短语；第二组是环保领域中与本短语在链条不同环节上重叠的术语。

entries.definition: Limits on what leaves a stack or engine; it is the air-side half of pollution control.
entries.definitionCN: 对烟囱或发动机排放的限制；它是污染控制中空气那一半。

entries.definition: Checking goods against specifications; it is industrial inspection, not environmental protection.
entries.definitionCN: 按规格检查产品；它是工业检验，而非环境保护。

entries.definition: Reduction of sound at its source or along its path; it handles one kind of pollution.
entries.definitionCN: 在声源或传播路径上降低声音；它只处理一种污染。

entries.definition: Heating, cooling and ventilation of a building; the phrase looks technical but serves comfort.
entries.definitionCN: 建筑的采暖、制冷与通风；这个短语看似技术，实为舒适服务。

entries.definition: Avoiding the generation of pollutants at all; control may allow some release and then limit it, while prevention refuses the release.
entries.definitionCN: 根本不产生污染物；control 容许一定排放再加以限制，prevention 则拒绝产生。

entries.definition: The lessening of a harmful emission, often used in law for noise and smoke; control is the wider system that includes abatement.
entries.definitionCN: 减轻有害排放，法律中常用于噪声与烟尘；control 是包含 abatement 的更广体系。

entries.definition: Repair of already contaminated ground or water; it works after pollution has occurred, while control works at the point of release.
entries.definitionCN: 对已被污染的土地或水进行修复；它在污染发生之后动手，而 control 在排放点动手。

entries.definition: Making a harm less severe, often of climate or habitat damage; it is broader than technical emission control.
entries.definitionCN: 使危害减轻，常用于气候或栖息地损害；它比技术性的排放控制更宽泛。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Control first meant checking a copy against a roll, so pollution control is checking a release against a standard.
normal.cn: control 最初指拿副本与卷册核对，因此污染控制就是拿排放与标准核对。

normal.en: The phrase covers device, law, price and process: scrubber, permit, levy and cleaner production.
normal.cn: 这个短语涵盖设备、法律、价格与工艺：洗涤器、许可证、税费与清洁生产。

normal.en: The family runs control, controller, controllable, uncontrolled and pollution-control.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 control、controller、controllable、uncontrolled 与 pollution-control。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: air pollution control, water pollution control, pollution control standards.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：空气污染控制、水污染控制、污染控制标准。

normal.en: Prevention refuses the release, control limits it, remediation repairs what already escaped.
normal.cn: prevention 拒绝排放，control 限制排放，remediation 修复已经逸出的部分。

abstract.en: Picture a valve turned until the needle falls back below a red line.
abstract.cn: 想象阀门被拧到指针落回红线以下。

abstract.en: Picture a fence built at the edge of a spill so it cannot spread.
abstract.cn: 想象在泄漏边缘筑起一道围栏，让它扩散不出去。

abstract.en: Picture a bill attached to every puff of smoke.
abstract.cn: 想象每一股烟都被贴上一张账单。

examples.en: Pollution control costs less than the damage it prevents.
examples.cn: 污染控制的成本低于它所避免的损害。

examples.en: The province tightened pollution control for the river basin.
examples.cn: 该省收紧了流域的污染控制。

examples.en: Good pollution control begins with measuring what leaves the plant.
examples.cn: 好的污染控制从测量工厂排出什么开始。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pollution（污染）+ control（控制）」——把污染管住 → 污染控制、防治污染

root: 英语复合短语：pollution 经法语出自拉丁 pollutio「玷污」，词根 polluere 的「洗 → 弄脏」转变存疑；control 经英法语 contreroller 出自中世纪拉丁 contrarotulus「对照卷」= contra-（对照）+ rotulus（小卷）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one loop: a release is measured, a limit is set, a device intercepts it, law enforces the limit, a price is attached, the process is cleaned upstream, monitoring closes the loop, and the same shape restrains any spillover.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个闭环展开：排放被测量、限值被设定、设备拦截、法律执行、价格挂钩、上游工艺变干净、监测闭合回路，最后同一形态约束任何外溢。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an operator turning a valve until the emission curve drops below the limit line.
core.cn: 核心意象：操作员拧动阀门，排放曲线落到限值线以下。

branches.en: CHECKING: the general definition and monitoring are the same act of comparing a release with a figure.
branches.cn: 核对：总定义与监测，都是把排放与一个数字作比较的同一动作。

branches.en: END OF PIPE: air scrubbers and water treatment both catch pollutants before they leave.
branches.cn: 管末端：空气洗涤器与水处理都在污染物离开之前把它截住。

branches.en: TWO INSTRUMENTS: a permit orders the limit and a levy prices it.
branches.cn: 两种工具：许可证下令限定，税费给限值标价。

branches.en: UPSTREAM: the cleanest control is a process that never makes the waste.
branches.cn: 上游：最干净的控制是根本不产生废物的工艺。

branches.en: TRANSFER: any unwanted outflow can be fenced by the same loop.
branches.cn: 转移：任何不受欢迎的外溢都能用同一闭环围住。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin-derived noun of defilement to a French-derived word of checking, so it can be read as two histories meeting.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁来源的「玷污」名词与法语来源的「核对」词连在一起，可以读作两段历史的相遇。

latinIntro.en: Latin rotulus 'little roll' gives control, controller and roll; contra- adds 'against'; pollutio gives pollution, pollute and pollutant.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 rotulus「小卷」衍生 control、controller 与 roll；contra- 添「对照」；pollutio 衍生 pollution、pollute 与 pollutant。

items.meaning: defilement; the state of being polluted
items.example: Pollution closed the shellfish beds.
items.exampleCN: 污染使贝类养殖区关闭。

items.example: The counter-roll was kept contra the original.
items.exampleCN: 对照卷是用来与正本核对的。

items.example: The clerk unrolled the rotulus.
items.exampleCN: 书吏展开了那卷册子。

items.example: The contrarotulus recorded the same sums twice.
items.exampleCN: 对照卷把同样的数目记了两遍。

items.example: The board controls the budget.
items.exampleCN: 董事会控制预算。

items.example: The controller signed every page.
items.exampleCN: 核对员在每一页上签字。

items.example: The leak was controllable.
items.exampleCN: 这次泄漏是可控的。

items.example: Uncontrolled burning filled the valley.
items.exampleCN: 不受控制的燃烧灌满了山谷。

items.example: The pollution-control office issued the permit.
items.exampleCN: 污染控制部门发放了许可证。

definition_zh: 环境退化；环境质量下降；土地、水、森林等自然系统结构与功能受损
definition_en: the decline in the quality, structure and functioning of natural systems such as land, water, forests and ecosystems
core_image: 牧场表土被风剥走，露出砾石与裂开的土纹，原本的草根悬在半空
scene: 曾经的牧场上，风把表土一层层吹走，露出砾石与裂开的土纹。Environmental degradation had turned the pasture into bare gravel within a decade.
sceneCN: 这里 environmental degradation 指「土地等自然系统的结构与生产力持续下降」（第 2 个义项：土地退化，含侵蚀、盐渍化与养分流失）；句意为环境退化在十年内把牧场变成了裸露砾石。图中可辨识物件：牧场、表土、砾石、裂开的土纹、悬空的草根。

pos.zh: 环境退化；环境质量下降（不可数名词短语，复数指多处或多类退化）

senses.title: General decline of environmental quality
senses.titleCN: 环境质量的总体下降
senses.definition: the broad worsening of air, water, land and living systems under human pressure
senses.definitionCN: 在人类压力下，空气、水、土地与生命系统的总体恶化
senses.example: Environmental degradation had turned the pasture into bare gravel within a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 环境退化在十年内把牧场变成了裸露砾石。
senses.why: Degradation is de- 'down' plus gradus 'step', so the phrase is literally a stepping down of the environment's condition.
senses.whyCN: degradation 是 de-「向下」加 gradus「台阶」，因此这个短语字面上就是环境状况「下了一个台阶」。

senses.title: Land and soil degradation
senses.titleCN: 土地与土壤退化
senses.definition: the loss of topsoil, nutrients, structure or productivity through erosion, salinity or compaction
senses.definitionCN: 因侵蚀、盐渍化或压实而失去表土、养分、结构或生产力
senses.example: Overgrazing drove environmental degradation across the dry hills.
senses.exampleCN: 过度放牧使干旱丘陵普遍出现环境退化。
senses.why: Soil is the slowest resource to rebuild, so land degradation is the sense most often meant by the phrase.
senses.whyCN: 土壤是最慢恢复的资源，因此土地退化是这个短语最常指的义项。

senses.title: Decline in water quality
senses.titleCN: 水质下降
senses.definition: the worsening of rivers, lakes, wetlands and aquifers through pollution, salinisation or over-extraction
senses.definitionCN: 河流、湖泊、湿地与含水层因污染、盐化或超采而变坏
senses.example: Wetland drainage caused environmental degradation downstream.
senses.exampleCN: 湿地排水造成了下游的环境退化。
senses.why: Water carries the effects of land use, so its decline is often the first visible sign of a wider degradation.
senses.whyCN: 水承载土地利用的后果，因此水质下降常是更大范围退化的第一个可见迹象。

senses.title: Forest degradation short of deforestation
senses.titleCN: 未完全毁林的森林退化
senses.definition: the loss of forest structure, canopy, species and carbon stock while the land still carries trees
senses.definitionCN: 土地仍有树木，但森林结构、冠层、物种与碳储量已经损失
senses.example: Selective logging produced forest degradation that satellites could barely see.
senses.exampleCN: 择伐造成的森林退化，卫星几乎看不出来。
senses.why: The phrase fills a gap: a forest can be badly degraded without ever becoming a clearing.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语填补了一个空缺：森林可以严重退化，却从未变成空地。

senses.title: Loss of ecosystem services
senses.titleCN: 生态系统服务的丧失
senses.definition: the decline in the benefits ecosystems provide, such as clean water, pollination and flood control
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统所提供的益处下降，如净水、授粉与防洪
senses.example: Environmental degradation showed up as lost pollination and dirtier water.
senses.exampleCN: 环境退化表现为授粉减少与水变脏。
senses.why: Once the phrase entered policy, it was measured by what people lose rather than by what the ecosystem looks like.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语进入政策之后，衡量的重点从生态系统「长什么样」转到「人们失去了什么」。

senses.title: Degradation of urban and industrial surroundings
senses.titleCN: 城市与工业周边的环境退化
senses.definition: the deterioration of air, soil and amenity around mines, factories and dense settlements
senses.definitionCN: 矿山、工厂与密集居住区周边空气、土壤与宜居性的恶化
senses.example: The old smelter left a ring of environmental degradation.
senses.exampleCN: 老冶炼厂在周围留下了一圈环境退化。
senses.why: Point sources concentrate harm, so the phrase often appears with a named site rather than a whole region.
senses.whyCN: 点状污染源使危害集中，因此这个短语常与具体场地连用，而非整个区域。

senses.title: A measured indicator in sustainability reporting
senses.titleCN: 可持续性报告中的量化指标
senses.definition: a tracked measure of land, water or ecosystem condition used to judge progress toward targets
senses.definitionCN: 用于判断目标进展的土地、水或生态系统状况的跟踪指标
senses.example: The report scored environmental degradation per river basin.
senses.exampleCN: 报告按流域给环境退化打分。
senses.why: Governance turns a process into a number, and the phrase becomes an item in a scorecard.
senses.whyCN: 治理把过程变成数字，这个短语于是成为计分表上的一项。

senses.title: Abstract: decline of any surrounding conditions
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何周边条件的恶化
senses.definition: a transferred use for the worsening of the conditions around a person, team or institution
senses.definitionCN: 转指一个人、团队或机构所处周边条件的恶化
senses.example: The survey measured environmental degradation inside the agency.
senses.exampleCN: 调查衡量了该机构内部环境的退化。
senses.why: Environment first meant simply 'the surroundings', so the phrase can leave ecology and describe any setting that is wearing down.
senses.whyCN: environment 最初只指「周围」，因此这个短语可以离开生态学，描述任何正在磨损的环境。

intro.en: Environmental degradation joins a French-derived word for surroundings to a Latin-derived word for stepping down. Both halves have long histories; the phrase is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: environmental degradation 把法语来源的「周围」词与拉丁来源的「下台阶」词连在一起。两半都有很长的历史，短语本身是近代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Environ meant 'around, about', from en- 'in' plus viron 'circle, circuit'. Viron goes back to virer 'to turn', whose own origin is uncertain; a link to Latin vibrare 'to vibrate' is a hypothesis, not a proved derivation.
items.cn: environ 意为「在周围」，由 en-「在」加 viron「圈子、环行」构成。viron 出自 virer「转」，而 virer 本身来源不确定；把它与拉丁 vibrare「振动」相联系只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: English environment first meant 'the state of being surrounded', then the physical surroundings, and only in the nineteenth century the natural world as a system.
items.cn: 英语 environment 最初指「被环绕的状态」，后指物理周边，直到十九世纪才指作为系统的自然界。

items.en: Gradus meant 'step, degree', from gradi 'to walk'. The deeper origin of gradi is not established; the root often proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: gradus 意为「台阶、等级」，出自 gradi「行走」。gradi 的更深来源未得到证明；常为它提出的词根属重构。

items.en: De- 'down' plus gradus produced degradare 'to lower in rank', and degradatio named that lowering; the earliest English sense was loss of rank or dignity.
items.cn: de-「向下」加 gradus 构成 degradare「降低等级」，degradatio 指这一降低；英语最早指失去位阶或尊严。

items.en: Once environment named the natural world, degradation was applied to soil, water and forests, and the phrase became standard in conservation writing.
items.cn: 当 environment 指自然界之后，degradation 被用于土壤、水与森林，这个短语遂成为保护写作中的标准说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (origin of virer, deeper origin of gradi, first date of the compound): the turning word behind environ is unsettled, the walking root behind gradus is unsettled, and the phrase has no fixed earliest citation, so its first date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（virer 的来源、gradi 的更深来源、该短语的首见年代）：environ 背后那个「转」的词无定论，gradus 背后「行走」的词根亦无定论，这个短语也没有最早书证的定论，首见年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds other environmental phrases that differ only in the noun of harm; group two holds specific processes that are often named as if they were the whole of degradation.
note.cn: 第一组是其他同含 environmental、只在「损害名词」上不同的短语；第二组是常被当作退化全部内容的具体过程。

entries.definition: Harm from a particular spill, fire or accident; damage can be sudden and bounded, while degradation is gradual and systemic.
entries.definitionCN: 来自某次泄漏、火灾或事故的损害；damage 可突然且有边界，degradation 则渐进且系统性。

entries.definition: A general worsening of conditions; it is close to degradation but lacks the technical sense of lost structure and function.
entries.definitionCN: 状况的总体恶化；与 degradation 接近，但少了「结构与功能丧失」的技术含义。

entries.definition: The using-up of a resource stock such as groundwater or fish; it counts what is taken, not what is damaged.
entries.definitionCN: 地下水或鱼类等资源存量的耗竭；它算的是取走了多少，而不是损坏了什么。

entries.definition: The presence of a harmful substance in a medium; it is one cause of degradation, not the whole decline.
entries.definitionCN: 有害物质存在于某种介质；它是退化的一个原因，而非整个下降过程。

entries.definition: Land degradation in dry regions that turns productive ground into desert-like conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 干旱地区的土地退化，使有生产力的土地变成类似荒漠的状态。

entries.definition: The wearing away of soil or rock by wind and water; it is one process within land degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤或岩石被风与水磨去；它是土地退化中的一种过程。

entries.definition: The clearing of forest cover; it is a drastic case that may be followed by degradation of what remains.
entries.definitionCN: 森林覆盖被清除；它是剧烈情形，其后可能跟着剩余部分的退化。

entries.definition: Any downward change in quantity or quality; the phrase fixes that general word to the environment.
entries.definitionCN: 数量或品质的任何下降；本短语只是把这个泛用词限定到环境。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Degradation is de- 'down' plus gradus 'step': the environment stepping down one grade.
normal.cn: degradation 是 de-「向下」加 gradus「台阶」：环境往下走了一个等级。

normal.en: Environment first meant 'surroundings', so the phrase is literally the decline of what surrounds us.
normal.cn: environment 最初指「周围」，因此这个短语字面上就是「我们周围之物的下降」。

normal.en: The family runs degrade, degradation, degraded, degradable and degradative.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 degrade、degradation、degraded、degradable 与 degradative。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark policy: prevent environmental degradation, reverse environmental degradation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出政策语境：防止环境退化、扭转环境退化。

normal.en: Forest degradation is not deforestation: trees can remain while structure and species are lost.
normal.cn: 森林退化不等于毁林：树还可以在，结构与物种却已失去。

abstract.en: Picture topsoil leaving a field in a single gust and the stones left behind.
abstract.cn: 想象一阵风把表土吹离田地，只剩石头。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase whose steps are worn into a ramp.
abstract.cn: 想象一段台阶被磨成了斜坡。

abstract.en: Picture an office where the windows no longer open and the noise never stops.
abstract.cn: 想象一间窗户再也打不开、噪声不停的办公室。

examples.en: Environmental degradation often begins where the soil is bare.
examples.cn: 环境退化常常从土壤裸露的地方开始。

examples.en: The map showed environmental degradation spreading along the river.
examples.cn: 地图显示环境退化沿河扩散。

examples.en: Reversing environmental degradation takes decades, not seasons.
examples.cn: 扭转环境退化需要数十年，而不是几个季节。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「environmental（环境的）+ degradation（降级）」——环境掉了一个台阶 → 环境退化

root: 英语复合短语：environment 经古法语 environ「周围」出自 en- + viron「环行」，viron 出自 virer「转」而来源不确定；degradation 经法语出自晚期拉丁 degradare「降级」= de-（向下）+ gradus「台阶」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one sliding step: a baseline condition is put under pressure, structure goes first, function follows, services are lost, repair gets harder, the loss is scored, and the same shape describes any worsening setting.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次下滑展开：原本的状况受到压力，结构先失，功能随后，服务丧失，修复变难，损失被计分，最后同一形态描述任何变坏的环境。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pasture losing its topsoil until only gravel and cracks remain.
core.cn: 核心意象：牧场失去表土，最后只剩砾石与裂缝。

branches.en: THE THREE GROUNDS: the general decline shows first in soil, water and the land surface.
branches.cn: 三块地基：总体下降最先显现在土壤、水与地表。

branches.en: FOREST CASE: trees may stand while the forest itself is degraded.
branches.cn: 森林情形：树还站着，森林本身却已退化。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT: what people lose becomes what reports count.
branches.cn: 计量：人们失去的东西，成为报告所统计的东西。

branches.en: SITE: mines and smelters concentrate the decline into one visible ring.
branches.cn: 场地：矿山与冶炼厂把退化收束成一圈可见的痕迹。

branches.en: TRANSFER: any setting can step down a grade.
branches.cn: 转移：任何环境都可以往下掉一个等级。

intro.en: The phrase joins two derived words, one French and one Latin, each of which can be read as prefix plus root plus suffix.
intro.cn: 这个短语把两个派生词连在一起，一个来自法语，一个来自拉丁语，各自都能读作前缀加词根加后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin gradus 'step' gives grade, gradual, graduate, upgrade, downgrade and degrade; de- adds 'down'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 gradus「台阶」衍生 grade、gradual、graduate、upgrade、downgrade 与 degrade；de- 添「向下」。

items.example: The walls environ the garden.
items.exampleCN: 墙环绕着花园。

items.example: Environment names what surrounds us.
items.exampleCN: environment 指环绕我们之物。

items.example: The prefix marks a step downward.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出向下的一步。

items.example: Each gradus was cut into the rock.
items.exampleCN: 每一级台阶都凿进岩石。

items.example: The suffix makes degradation a named process.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把 degradation 变成一个有名称的过程。

items.meaning: to lower in quality or rank
items.example: Ploughing steep slopes degrades the soil.
items.exampleCN: 在陡坡上耕作会使土壤退化。

items.example: Soil degradation followed the drought.
items.exampleCN: 旱情之后接着是土壤退化。

items.example: The degraded rangeland held no grass.
items.exampleCN: 退化的牧场上没有草。

items.example: The bag was degradable in soil.
items.exampleCN: 这种袋子在土壤中可降解。

items.example: The environmental report was delayed.
items.exampleCN: 环境报告被推迟了。

latinEntries.structure: gradi, gressus sum (verb, third conjugation, deponent)

definition_zh: 退化；降解；品质下降；地位或尊严的降低
definition_en: the process of falling to a lower quality, condition, rank or structural state
core_image: 一块塑料样片在紫外灯下慢慢泛黄、开裂，最后一捏就碎
scene: 实验室的架子上，一块塑料样片在紫外灯下泛黄开裂，手指一捏就碎。Ultraviolet light caused degradation of the sample within weeks.
sceneCN: 这里 degradation 指「材料因光照、氧化等作用而逐渐失去原有性能」（第 4 个义项：材料退化与老化）；句意为紫外光在几周内使样片发生降解。图中可辨识物件：塑料样片、紫外灯、泛黄裂纹、碎屑。

pos.zh: 退化；降解；降级；品质或尊严的降低

senses.title: A general fall in quality or condition
senses.titleCN: 品质或状况的总体下降
senses.definition: the process by which something loses quality, value or good condition over time
senses.definitionCN: 某物随时间失去品质、价值或良好状态的过程
senses.example: Ultraviolet light caused degradation of the sample within weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 紫外光在几周内使样片发生降解。
senses.why: The word is de- 'down' plus gradus 'step', so degradation is a movement down one grade rather than a sudden collapse.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 de-「向下」加 gradus「台阶」，因此 degradation 是往下走一个等级，而非突然崩塌。

senses.title: Land and soil degradation
senses.titleCN: 土地与土壤退化
senses.definition: the loss of soil fertility, structure or cover through erosion, salinity, compaction or overuse
senses.definitionCN: 因侵蚀、盐渍化、压实或过度使用而失去肥力、结构或覆盖
senses.example: Continuous cropping sped up the degradation of the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 连作加快了山坡的退化。
senses.why: Soil is a slowly renewed body, so its degradation is measured in decades and is hard to reverse.
senses.whyCN: 土壤是缓慢更新的整体，其退化以十年计，且难以逆转。

senses.title: Chemical breakdown of a substance
senses.titleCN: 物质的化学降解
senses.definition: the breaking of large molecules into smaller ones by heat, light, water or microbial action
senses.definitionCN: 大分子因热、光、水或微生物作用而断裂为较小分子
senses.example: The polymer's degradation released a faint acid smell.
senses.exampleCN: 这种聚合物的降解释放出一股淡淡的酸味。
senses.why: Chemistry uses the word for the loss of a molecule's structure, which is a literal stepping down of complexity.
senses.whyCN: 化学用这个词指分子结构的丧失，也就是复杂度的字面「降级」。

senses.title: Material degradation in service
senses.titleCN: 使用中的材料退化
senses.definition: the loss of strength, colour or function in a material through corrosion, wear, heat or radiation
senses.definitionCN: 材料因腐蚀、磨损、热或辐射而失去强度、颜色或功能
senses.example: Salt air caused steady degradation of the bridge cables.
senses.exampleCN: 含盐的海风使桥梁缆索持续退化。
senses.why: Engineering watches degradation as a rate, because safety depends on how fast a material steps down.
senses.whyCN: 工程把退化看作一个速率，因为安全取决于材料下降得多快。

senses.title: Social or moral debasement
senses.titleCN: 社会或道德上的贬损
senses.definition: the lowering of a person or group to a condition of humiliation, exploitation or loss of dignity
senses.definitionCN: 使人或群体陷入屈辱、剥削或失去尊严的状态
senses.example: The report described the degradation of workers in the camps.
senses.exampleCN: 报告描述了营地里工人所受的贬损。
senses.why: The word's oldest English sense is a falling from dignity, and it still carries moral weight.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早的英语义项是「从尊严上跌落」，至今仍带道德分量。

senses.title: Ceremonial loss of rank
senses.titleCN: 仪式性的降级与褫夺
senses.definition: the formal stripping of a title, office or rank, once performed in public ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 正式剥夺头衔、职务或军阶，旧时在公开仪式中执行
senses.example: The old rite of degradation removed the knight's belt and spurs.
senses.exampleCN: 旧的降级礼卸下了骑士的腰带与马刺。
senses.why: This is the literal sense of de- plus gradus: a person is moved down a step of the hierarchy.
senses.whyCN: 这是 de- 加 gradus 的字面义：一个人被移下等级阶梯的一级。

senses.title: Habitat degradation in ecology
senses.titleCN: 生态学中的栖息地退化
senses.definition: the loss of a habitat's structure and species composition while some of it remains
senses.definitionCN: 栖息地仍有部分留存，但其结构与物种组成已丧失
senses.example: Draining the marsh caused habitat degradation for nesting birds.
senses.exampleCN: 排干沼泽造成了营巢鸟类的栖息地退化。
senses.why: Ecology needs a word for partial loss, because a habitat can be ruined without being erased.
senses.whyCN: 生态学需要一个词指「部分丧失」，因为栖息地可以已经被毁，却并未消失。

senses.title: Signal or data degradation
senses.titleCN: 信号或数据的劣化
senses.definition: the loss of clarity, accuracy or resolution in a transmitted signal or stored dataset
senses.definitionCN: 传输信号或存储数据集在清晰度、准确度或分辨率上的损失
senses.example: Repeated copying caused degradation of the recording.
senses.exampleCN: 反复复制使这段录音出现劣化。
senses.why: Information theory borrowed the word because quality can step down through a chain without anything being added.
senses.whyCN: 信息论借用这个词，因为品质可以在一连串环节中下降，而并未添加任何东西。

senses.title: Abstract: erosion of institutional trust
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：制度与信任的侵蚀
senses.definition: a transferred use for the gradual weakening of standards, trust or co-operation in an organisation
senses.definitionCN: 转指组织内标准、信任或合作的逐渐削弱
senses.example: Repeated exceptions led to degradation of the safety rules.
senses.exampleCN: 一再例外导致安全规则逐渐失效。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the staircase: each small exception is one step down, and the height is lost a step at a time.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了楼梯：每一次小小的例外都是一级台阶，高度是一级一级失去的。

intro.en: Degradation came to English from French and Latin, built on gradus 'step'. Its first English sense was a falling away from a former state, and the rank sense followed. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: degradation 经法语与拉丁语进入英语，构自 gradus「台阶」。它最早的英语义项是「从原有状态跌落」，降级义随后出现。年代均为约数。

items.en: Gradus meant 'step, degree', from the verb gradi 'to walk'. The deeper origin of gradi is not established; the root commonly proposed for it is a reconstruction rather than a recorded form.
items.cn: gradus 意为「台阶、等级」，出自动词 gradi「行走」。gradi 的更深来源未得到证明；常为它提出的词根是重构，而非有记录的形式。

items.en: De- 'down' plus gradus produced degradare 'to lower in rank', used first of clergy and officials moved down the hierarchy.
items.cn: de-「向下」加 gradus 构成 degradare「降低等级」，最初用于被移下等级的教士与官员。

items.en: Old French degradacion and English degradation appear in the fourteenth century with the sense of deterioration or degeneration, a falling from a former condition.
items.cn: 古法语 degradacion 与英语 degradation 在十四世纪出现，指恶化、变质，即从原有状态跌落。

items.en: By the sixteenth century the word also named the public ceremony that stripped a knight or officer of rank.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，这个词也指公开剥夺骑士或军官职级的仪式。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries chemistry, materials science and ecology adopted the word for the breakdown of substances, structures and habitats.
items.cn: 十九与二十世纪，化学、材料科学与生态学采用这个词来指物质、结构与栖息地的崩解。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin of gradi, first date of the scientific sense): the walking root behind gradus is unsettled, and no single earliest citation is fixed for the chemical or ecological sense, so its date is approximate; any older form offered for gradi is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（gradi 的更深来源、科学义的首见年代）：gradus 背后「行走」的词根无定论，化学义与生态义的最早书证也无定论，年代只能约计；凡为 gradi 给出的更早形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same gradus stock that differ in grammar or sense; group two holds other words for falling quality, each stressing a different kind of loss.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 gradus 词干、语法或含义不同的词；第二组是其他表示品质下降的词，各自强调不同的损失。

entries.definition: To lower something in quality or rank; degradation is the process or result the verb produces.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物品质或等级下降；degradation 是动词所产生过程或结果。

entries.definition: A series of steps or stages, from the same gradus root; it names an orderly scale, not a fall.
entries.definitionCN: 一系列台阶或阶段，同出 gradus 词根；它指有序的刻度，而非跌落。

entries.definition: Happening by small steps, from gradus; the adjective describes pace, not loss of quality.
entries.definitionCN: 逐步发生的，出自 gradus；这个形容词描述节奏，而非品质损失。

entries.definition: To raise something to a higher grade; it reverses the de- of degradation while using the same root.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物提升到更高等级；它与 degradation 的 de- 方向相反，却用同一词根。

entries.definition: Any worsening of condition; it is broader and less technical than degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 状况的任何恶化；它比 degradation 更宽泛、更少技术性。

entries.definition: Slow rotting or decomposition, especially of organic matter; degradation also covers metals, data and rank.
entries.definitionCN: 缓慢的腐烂或分解，尤指有机物；degradation 还涵盖金属、数据与等级。

entries.definition: The lowering of value, purity or dignity, as of coinage or character; it is a moral or monetary word.
entries.definitionCN: 价值、纯度或尊严的降低，如货币成色或人格；它是道德或货币领域的词。

entries.definition: Chemical attack on a metal surface; it is one cause of material degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 对金属表面的化学侵蚀；它是材料退化的一个原因。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: De- 'down' plus gradus 'step': degradation is one step down the staircase.
normal.cn: de-「向下」加 gradus「台阶」：degradation 就是楼梯下了一级。

normal.en: The same root gives grade, gradual, graduate, upgrade and downgrade.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 grade、gradual、graduate、upgrade 与 downgrade。

normal.en: The family runs degrade, degraded, degradable, degradative and degradability.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 degrade、degraded、degradable、degradative 与 degradability。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: land degradation, chemical degradation, material degradation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：土地退化、化学降解、材料退化。

normal.en: The oldest English sense was moral: a falling from dignity, not a falling of soil.
normal.cn: 最早的英语义项是道德性的：从尊严跌落，而非土壤流失。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase where each step is worn a little lower than the one before.
abstract.cn: 想象一段楼梯，每一级都比上一级磨得更低。

abstract.en: Picture a copied tape played again and again until the voice blurs.
abstract.cn: 想象一盘磁带被反复翻录，声音渐渐糊掉。

abstract.en: Picture a rule broken once for convenience, then again, until nobody cites it.
abstract.cn: 想象一条规则为图方便被破一次，再破一次，直到没人再提它。

examples.en: Heat and moisture accelerate the degradation of the coating.
examples.cn: 热与湿气加快涂层的退化。

examples.en: Land degradation lowered the yield of the whole district.
examples.cn: 土地退化降低了大片地区的产量。

examples.en: The term also names the degradation of a person's dignity.
examples.cn: 这个词也指一个人尊严的贬损。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「de（向下）+ grad（台阶）+ ation」——品质往下走一级 → 退化、降解

root: 拉丁 degradare「降低等级」= de-（向下）+ gradus「台阶」，gradus 出自 gradi「行走」，gradi 的更深来源不确定；英语义最早指「从原有状态跌落」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one staircase: a higher condition exists, a step is taken downward, quality falls, structure breaks, standing falls, and finally the same image describes signals and institutions.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一段楼梯展开：本来处在较高状态，向下走一级，品质下降，结构断裂，地位跌落，最后同一意象描述信号与制度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a step worn lower than the one before it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一级比上一级磨得更低的台阶。

branches.en: GENERAL AND LAND: any quality can step down, and soil is the slowest case to repair.
branches.cn: 总体与土地：任何品质都能下台阶，土壤是最慢修复的一种。

branches.en: MATTER: molecules break apart and materials lose strength by the same downward movement.
branches.cn: 物质：分子断裂与材料失强，是同一种向下的运动。

branches.en: HUMAN STANDING: dignity and rank fall on the same scale as quality.
branches.cn: 人的地位：尊严与职级同品质一样沿同一尺度下落。

branches.en: HABITAT: a place can be degraded while still partly standing.
branches.cn: 栖息地：一个地方可以已经退化，却仍部分存在。

branches.en: TRANSFER: signals and trust lose resolution the way materials lose strength.
branches.cn: 转移：信号与信任失去清晰度，正如材料失去强度。

intro.en: Degradation is a Latin-derived noun with a prefix, a step root and an action suffix, and the root also builds a large English family.
intro.cn: degradation 是拉丁来源名词，含前缀、台阶词根与动作后缀，这个词根还构成一个很大的英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin gradus gives grade, gradation, gradual, graduate, degrade, upgrade and downgrade; de- adds 'down'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 gradus 衍生 grade、gradation、gradual、graduate、degrade、upgrade 与 downgrade；de- 添「向下」。

items.example: The prefix marks the downward direction.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出向下的方向。

items.example: The rank was one gradus below the other.
items.exampleCN: 这个等级比另一个低一级。

items.example: The root image is walking down a stair.
items.exampleCN: 词根意象是沿楼梯往下走。

items.example: The suffix makes the process a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把过程变成名词。

items.meaning: to lower in quality or rank
items.example: Light degrades the pigment.
items.exampleCN: 光会使颜料退化。

items.example: The degradation was visible in the cracks.
items.exampleCN: 退化从裂纹上就能看出。

items.example: The degraded alloy crumbled.
items.exampleCN: 退化的合金碎了。

items.example: The mulch was fully degradable.
items.exampleCN: 这种覆盖物完全可降解。

items.example: The gradation from light to dark was smooth.
items.exampleCN: 从浅到深的过渡很平滑。

items.meaning: to raise to a higher grade
items.example: They upgraded the plant.
items.exampleCN: 他们升级了工厂。
