definition_zh: 修复；补救；整治；对受污染场地或受损系统采取的治疗性措施
definition_en: the act of correcting a harm or repairing a damaged system, especially the cleanup of a contaminated site
core_image: 废弃加油站的地面上，工人铲起被油浸黑的表土，送进一台加热脱附的机器
scene: 废弃的加油站场地上，工人把受油污染的表土铲进热脱附设备。Remediation of the old fuel site took three years.
sceneCN: 这里 remediation 指「对受污染场地进行清理与整治」（第 2 个义项：把土壤、地下水中的污染物去除或降低到安全水平）；句意为这座旧燃料场地的修复用了三年。图中可辨识物件：废弃加油站、油污表土、铲斗、热脱附设备。

pos.zh: 修复；补救；整治（不可数，复数指多项修复工程）

senses.title: The act of putting a fault right
senses.titleCN: 纠正缺陷、把问题修好
senses.definition: the general act of correcting a fault, weakness or bad condition in something
senses.definitionCN: 纠正某物中的缺陷、弱点或不良状况的总体行为
senses.example: Remediation of the old fuel site took three years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧燃料场地的修复用了三年。
senses.why: Remediation comes from Latin remedium 'a cure', built on re- 'again' plus mederi 'to heal', so it carries the idea of treating a disorder rather than merely covering it.
senses.whyCN: remediation 出自拉丁 remedium「治疗之物」，由 re-「再」加 mederi「治愈」构成，因此带有「治疗失调」而非「遮盖」的意思。

senses.title: Cleanup of a contaminated site
senses.titleCN: 受污染场地的清理整治
senses.definition: the removal, containment or destruction of pollutants in soil, water or buildings so that the site can be used safely
senses.definitionCN: 去除、封存或销毁土壤、水体或建筑中的污染物，使场地可安全使用
senses.example: The state ordered remediation of every closed landfill.
senses.exampleCN: 该州下令对每一座关闭的填埋场进行修复。
senses.why: Environmental law gave the word its dominant modern sense, because a site that has been harmed must be brought back to a usable state.
senses.whyCN: 环境法赋予这个词最主要的现代义，因为受损的场地必须被恢复到可使用状态。

senses.title: Soil remediation
senses.titleCN: 土壤修复
senses.definition: physical, chemical or biological treatment that lowers soil contamination to an accepted level
senses.definitionCN: 把土壤污染降到公认水平的物理、化学或生物处理
senses.example: Thermal treatment was chosen for the soil remediation.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤修复选用了热处理。
senses.why: Soil is the medium that holds contaminants longest, so its treatment is the most visible form of remediation work.
senses.whyCN: 土壤是留住污染物最久的介质，因此它的处理是修复工程中最可见的形式。

senses.title: Groundwater remediation
senses.titleCN: 地下水修复
senses.definition: pumping, treating or chemically converting polluted groundwater until it meets a standard
senses.definitionCN: 把受污染的地下水抽出、处理或用化学方法转化，直到达标
senses.example: Pump-and-treat groundwater remediation ran for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 抽出—处理式的地下水修复持续了十年。
senses.why: Groundwater moves and spreads, so its remediation is slow and is usually described by the method used.
senses.whyCN: 地下水会流动扩散，因此其修复缓慢，通常以所用方法命名。

senses.title: Ecological restoration of a damaged habitat
senses.titleCN: 受损栖息地的生态修复
senses.definition: work that rebuilds the structure, species and processes of a habitat rather than only removing a pollutant
senses.definitionCN: 重建栖息地的结构、物种与过程，而不只是去除某种污染物
senses.example: Wetland remediation brought the reed beds back.
senses.exampleCN: 湿地修复让芦苇荡重新长回来。
senses.why: Remediation can aim at function rather than purity: a habitat is treated until it works again.
senses.whyCN: 修复的目标可以是功能而非纯净：栖息地被整治到能重新运转。

senses.title: Remedial teaching in education
senses.titleCN: 教育中的补习与补救教学
senses.definition: extra instruction given to students who have fallen behind in a subject
senses.definitionCN: 为在某一科目上落后的学生提供的额外教学
senses.example: The school added reading remediation for the lower grades.
senses.exampleCN: 学校为低年级增加了阅读补习。
senses.why: Education uses the same medical shape: a weakness is diagnosed and treated with targeted practice.
senses.whyCN: 教育使用同样的医学形态：先诊断弱点，再用有针对性的练习治疗。

senses.title: Legal remedy and redress
senses.titleCN: 法律上的补救与救济
senses.definition: a legal means of putting right a wrong, such as compensation or an order to correct a defect
senses.definitionCN: 纠正过错的法律手段，如赔偿或责令改正
senses.example: The contract gave the buyer remediation for the faulty roof.
senses.exampleCN: 合同赋予买方对缺陷屋顶的补救权。
senses.why: Law borrowed the cure word because a right without a remedy is only a statement.
senses.whyCN: 法律借用「治疗」一词，因为没有救济的权利只是一句声明。

senses.title: Security and software remediation
senses.titleCN: 信息安全与软件的修复
senses.definition: the patching or reconfiguration of a system to close a vulnerability or correct a fault
senses.definitionCN: 通过打补丁或重新配置来封堵漏洞、纠正故障
senses.example: The team finished remediation of the exposed server by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在中午前完成了对暴露服务器的修复。
senses.why: Information security adopted the word because a known flaw must be treated before it is exploited.
senses.whyCN: 信息安全采用这个词，因为已知的缺陷必须在被利用之前处理掉。

senses.title: Abstract: making amends for harm done
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：为造成的损害作出补偿
senses.definition: a transferred use for the social or moral work of repairing damage one has caused
senses.definitionCN: 转指为修复自己造成的损害所做的社会或道德工作
senses.example: The company described its scholarship fund as remediation.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把它的奖学金基金称为一种补救。
senses.why: The medical image survives: a harm has been done, and something must be applied until the harmed body is whole again.
senses.whyCN: 医学意象仍然保留：损害已经发生，必须施加某种东西，直到受损的整体重新完整。

intro.en: Remediation is a modern English noun from Latin remedium 'a cure'. The medical image of treating a disorder runs through every sense. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: remediation 是近代英语名词，出自拉丁 remedium「治疗之物」。治疗失调的医学意象贯穿所有义项。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mederi meant 'to heal, to look after'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; the root often proposed for it, with the sense 'take appropriate measures', is a reconstruction rather than an attested form.
items.cn: mederi 意为「治愈、照料」。其更深来源不确定；常为它提出的、意为「采取适当措施」的词根是重构，而非有书证的形式。

items.en: Re- 'again' plus mederi produced remedium 'a cure, a remedy', the thing applied so that health returns.
items.cn: re-「再」加 mederi 构成 remedium「治疗之物、补救办法」，即为了恢复健康而施加的东西。

items.en: Old French remedie brought remedy into English in the fourteenth century, first for a medicine and then for any correction of a wrong.
items.cn: 古法语 remedie 在十四世纪把 remedy 带入英语，先指药物，后指对过错的任何纠正。

items.en: The adjective remedial followed in the seventeenth century; the noun remediation was formed later on the same Latin base.
items.cn: 形容词 remedial 随后在十七世纪出现；名词 remediation 后来在同一拉丁词基上构成。

items.en: Late twentieth-century environmental law made site remediation a standard procedure, and this sense now dominates technical use.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期的环境法使场地修复成为标准程序，这一义项如今在技术用法中占主导。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin of mederi, first date of the noun): the healing root behind mederi is unsettled, and no single earliest citation is fixed for remediation in its environmental sense, so its date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（mederi 的更深来源、该名词的首见年代）：mederi 背后「治愈」的词根无定论，remediation 的环境义也没有公认的最早书证，年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds words that look close to remediation but come from mederi 'to heal' or from medius 'middle'; the two roots are not related. Group two holds other words for undoing harm.
note.cn: 第一组是外形接近 remediation 的词，分别出自 mederi「治愈」或 medius「中间」，两个词根并无亲缘；第二组是其他表示「消除损害」的词。

entries.definition: A cure or correction, from the same remedium; remediation is the process of applying remedies at scale.
entries.definitionCN: 治疗或纠正，同出 remedium；remediation 是大规模施加补救的过程。

entries.definition: Serving to cure or correct, as in remedial teaching; it describes the treatment, not the whole programme.
entries.definitionCN: 用于治疗或纠正的，如补习教学；它描述治疗，而非整套方案。

entries.definition: To act between two sides to settle a dispute, from Latin medius 'middle'; the similarity to remediate is formal only.
entries.definitionCN: 居于两方之间以解决争端，出自拉丁 medius「中间」；与 remediate 的相似只是形式上的。

entries.definition: Assisted negotiation between parties, from medius 'middle'; it settles a dispute rather than repairing damage.
entries.definitionCN: 由第三方协助的谈判，出自 medius「中间」；它解决争端，而非修复损害。

entries.definition: Returning something to a former or better condition; restoration aims at the original state, while remediation aims at safety.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物回到原先或更好的状态；restoration 以求复原状为目标，remediation 以安全为目标。

entries.definition: The everyday term for removing pollution; remediation is its formal and regulatory counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 去除污染的日常说法；remediation 是其正式、监管用语中的对应词。

entries.definition: Making a harm less severe; mitigation reduces the effect, while remediation treats the damaged medium itself.
entries.definitionCN: 使危害减轻；mitigation 减小影响，remediation 则处理受损的介质本身。

entries.definition: Bringing spoiled land into a usable condition, as after mining; it stresses future use rather than removal of a pollutant.
entries.definitionCN: 把废弃土地恢复到可用状态，如采矿之后；它强调未来用途，而非去除污染物。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Remediation is re- 'again' plus mederi 'to heal': apply again until the patient is whole.
normal.cn: remediation 是 re-「再」加 mederi「治愈」：一次又一次施加，直到整体复原。

normal.en: The family runs remedy, remedial, remediate, remediable and irremediable.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 remedy、remedial、remediate、remediable 与 irremediable。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: site remediation, soil remediation, groundwater remediation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：场地修复、土壤修复、地下水修复。

normal.en: Remediate comes from mederi 'heal'; mediate comes from medius 'middle'. They are not relatives.
normal.cn: remediate 出自 mederi「治愈」；mediate 出自 medius「中间」。二者并非同族。

normal.en: The school sense keeps the medical shape: find the weakness, then treat it with practice.
normal.cn: 教育义保留了医学形态：先找出弱点，再用练习治疗。

abstract.en: Picture a wound cleaned and bound until the skin closes again.
abstract.cn: 想象伤口被清洗包扎，直到皮肤重新合上。

abstract.en: Picture a patch sewn over a tear in a sail before the wind finds it.
abstract.cn: 想象在风找到裂口之前，先给帆补上一块。

abstract.en: Picture a debt repaid slowly, not cancelled.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔债被慢慢偿还，而不是被勾销。

examples.en: Remediation costs are often paid by the party that caused the contamination.
examples.cn: 修复费用通常由造成污染的一方支付。

examples.en: Bioremediation uses microbes to break down the oil in the soil.
examples.cn: 生物修复利用微生物分解土壤中的油。

examples.en: The school's remediation programme targets reading and arithmetic.
examples.cn: 该校的补救教学计划针对阅读与算术。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）+ medi（治愈）+ ation」——再治一次，直到恢复 → 修复、补救

root: 拉丁 remedium「治疗之物」= re-（再）+ mederi「治愈、照料」；mederi 的更深来源不确定，常被提出的「采取适当措施」词根属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one cure: a fault is found, its cause is treated, the medium is cleaned, function returns, law requires it, and finally the same image covers teaching, software and amends.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一次治疗展开：先发现缺陷，再处理成因，接着清理介质，功能恢复，法律要求如此，最后同一意象覆盖教学、软件与补偿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: oil-black soil lifted from an old filling station and fed into a heated cleaner.
core.cn: 核心意象：从旧加油站铲起油黑的土，送进加热的净化设备。

branches.en: CURE AND SITE: the general correction and the contaminated site are the same treatment at two scales.
branches.cn: 治疗与场地：总体纠正与受污染场地，是同一治疗在两个尺度上。

branches.en: TWO MEDIA: soil is treated in place or by heating, groundwater by pumping and treating.
branches.cn: 两种介质：土壤就地处理或加热处理，地下水则抽出处理。

branches.en: FUNCTION: restoration aims at a working habitat, not merely a clean sample.
branches.cn: 功能：修复瞄准的是能运转的栖息地，而不只是干净的样本。

branches.en: TREATMENT ELSEWHERE: a weak pupil and a wronged buyer are both given a remedy.
branches.cn: 别处的治疗：落后的学生与受屈的买家，都被给了一剂补救。

branches.en: TRANSFER: a server flaw and a social harm are treated like a wound.
branches.cn: 转移：服务器漏洞与社会损害，都像伤口一样被处理。

intro.en: Remediation is a Latin-derived noun of curing, with a prefix, a healing root and an action suffix; its look-alike mediate belongs to a different root.
intro.cn: remediation 是拉丁来源的「治疗」名词，含前缀、治愈词根与动作后缀；外形相近的 mediate 属于另一个词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin mederi gives remedy, remedial, remediate and irremediable; Latin medius 'middle' gives mediate, mediation, medium and immediate, which are not relatives of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 mederi 衍生 remedy、remedial、remediate 与 irremediable；拉丁 medius「中间」衍生 mediate、mediation、medium 与 immediate，后者与本词族并非同族。

items.example: The prefix marks a repeated application.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出反复施加。

items.example: The root carries the image of medical care.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着医疗照护的意象。

items.example: Remedium was the thing applied.
items.exampleCN: remedium 是被施加的那个东西。

items.example: The remedy was rest and clean water.
items.exampleCN: 治疗之物是休息与干净的水。

items.example: The suffix turns the cure into a process.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把治疗变成过程。

items.meaning: the act of curing or correcting
items.example: Remediation of the site began in spring.
items.exampleCN: 场地修复在春天开始。

items.example: They remediated the contaminated soil.
items.exampleCN: 他们修复了受污染的土壤。

items.example: Remedial classes met after school.
items.exampleCN: 补习班放学后上课。

items.example: The fault was remediable.
items.exampleCN: 这个缺陷是可以补救的。

items.example: The loss was irremediable.
items.exampleCN: 这一损失无法补救。

latinEntries.structure: medius, media, medium (adjective, first and second declension)

definition_zh: 环境修复；污染场地整治；使受损害的土壤、水体或生态系统恢复安全与功能
definition_en: the work of cleaning up contaminated soil, water or ecosystems and returning them to a safe and functioning state
core_image: 旧厂院里堆起几座深色土丘，四周铺着防渗膜，远处一台挖掘机还在作业
scene: 旧工厂的院子里，挖掘机把深色土壤堆成几座土丘，四周铺着防渗膜。Environmental remediation turned the abandoned yard into a park.
sceneCN: 这里 environmental remediation 指「受污染场地的整体清理与恢复」（第 1 个义项：对受损环境的综合整治，使之重新安全可用）；句意为环境修复把废弃厂院变成了公园。图中可辨识物件：旧厂院、深色土丘、防渗膜、挖掘机。

pos.zh: 环境修复；污染场地整治（不可数名词短语）

senses.title: Overall cleanup of a damaged environment
senses.titleCN: 受损环境的整体清理与恢复
senses.definition: the combined technical and regulatory work that cleans a contaminated site and restores it to safe use
senses.definitionCN: 清理受污染场地并使其恢复安全使用的技术与监管工作的总和
senses.example: Environmental remediation turned the abandoned yard into a park.
senses.exampleCN: 环境修复把废弃厂院变成了公园。
senses.why: The phrase pairs a word for surroundings with a word for curing, so it names treatment applied to a place rather than to a patient.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把「周围」与「治愈」两个词配在一起，因此指的是施加在「地方」而非「病人」身上的治疗。

senses.title: Soil remediation
senses.titleCN: 土壤修复
senses.definition: digging, heating, washing or biologically treating soil until contaminants fall to accepted levels
senses.definitionCN: 通过挖掘、加热、洗涤或生物处理，使土壤污染物降到公认水平
senses.example: Environmental remediation began with the removal of the top metre of soil.
senses.exampleCN: 环境修复从挖走表层一米土壤开始。
senses.why: Soil holds contaminants and cannot simply be flushed, so excavation and treatment dominate this sense.
senses.whyCN: 土壤会留住污染物，又不能简单冲走，因此挖掘与处理在这个义项中占主导。

senses.title: Groundwater remediation
senses.titleCN: 地下水修复
senses.definition: extracting, treating or converting polluted groundwater, often with barriers and monitoring wells
senses.definitionCN: 抽出、处理或转化受污染的地下水，常配合阻隔墙与监测井
senses.example: Environmental remediation kept the plume from reaching the town wells.
senses.exampleCN: 环境修复阻止了污染羽到达城里的水井。
senses.why: Groundwater flows, so treatment must follow a moving target rather than a fixed volume.
senses.whyCN: 地下水会流动，因此处理必须追着一个移动的目标，而不是一个固定的体积。

senses.title: Sediment and marine cleanup
senses.titleCN: 沉积物与水域底泥清理
senses.definition: dredging, capping or monitored natural recovery of contaminated river and harbour beds
senses.definitionCN: 对受污染河流与港湾底泥进行疏浚、覆盖或监测下的自然恢复
senses.example: Environmental remediation of the harbour required dredging and capping.
senses.exampleCN: 港湾的环境修复需要疏浚与覆盖。
senses.why: Contaminants settle in beds, so a separate set of methods exists for the bottom of a water body.
senses.whyCN: 污染物会沉在底泥里，因此水体底部另有一套方法。

senses.title: A regulatory programme for contaminated sites
senses.titleCN: 污染场地的法定整治计划
senses.definition: the legal process of listing, assessing, funding and certifying the cleanup of a site
senses.definitionCN: 对场地进行登记、评估、出资与验收的法定程序
senses.example: The law made environmental remediation mandatory before any resale.
senses.exampleCN: 法律要求在转售之前必须完成环境修复。
senses.why: Liability drives the phrase: a site cannot change hands until its contamination has been addressed.
senses.whyCN: 责任推动了这个短语：场地在污染得到处理之前不能易手。

senses.title: Ecological restoration of habitat
senses.titleCN: 栖息地的生态恢复
senses.definition: rebuilding the plants, animals and processes of a damaged habitat so that it functions again
senses.definitionCN: 重建受损栖息地的植物、动物与过程，使其重新运转
senses.example: Environmental remediation replanted the banks and reopened the fish passage.
senses.exampleCN: 环境修复在河岸重新种植，并打通了鱼类通道。
senses.why: Remediation can aim at a living system rather than at a chemical threshold.
senses.whyCN: 修复的目标可以是活着的系统，而不只是一个化学阈值。

senses.title: Industrial site decommissioning
senses.titleCN: 工业场地的关停与清理
senses.definition: the closing, dismantling and cleansing of mines, refineries and factories at the end of their life
senses.definitionCN: 矿山、炼厂与工厂在生命周期结束时被关闭、拆除与净化
senses.example: Environmental remediation followed the closure of the smelter.
senses.exampleCN: 冶炼厂关闭之后接着进行环境修复。
senses.why: An industry leaves a footprint, and this sense names the work of lifting the foot.
senses.whyCN: 工业会留下脚印，这个义项就指把脚印抬起来的工作。

senses.title: Abstract: repairing damage to one's surroundings
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：修复自身所处环境的损害
senses.definition: a transferred use for mending the conditions around a group, such as trust or shared space
senses.definitionCN: 转指修补一个群体周围的状况，如信任或共用空间
senses.example: The department treated its broken routines as environmental remediation.
senses.exampleCN: 这个部门把被破坏的日常流程当作环境修复来处理。
senses.why: Because environment can mean any surroundings, the phrase can be used of an office or a community as well as a river.
senses.whyCN: 因为 environment 可指任何周边，这个短语既能用于河流，也能用于办公室或社区。

intro.en: Environmental remediation joins a French-derived word for surroundings to a Latin-derived word for curing. The phrase is late twentieth-century regulatory language. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: environmental remediation 把法语来源的「周围」词与拉丁来源的「治愈」词连在一起。这个短语是二十世纪后期的监管语言。年代均为约数。

items.en: Environ 'around' came from en- plus viron 'circle', and viron from virer 'to turn'. The origin of virer is uncertain; a link to Latin vibrare is a hypothesis.
items.cn: environ「周围」由 en- 加 viron「圈子」构成，viron 出自 virer「转」。virer 的来源不确定；把它与拉丁 vibrare 联系只是假说。

items.en: Environment first meant 'surroundings' and only in the nineteenth century came to mean the natural world as a system.
items.cn: environment 最初指「周围之物」，到十九世纪才指作为系统的自然界。

items.en: Mederi meant 'to heal, look after'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; the root commonly proposed for it is a reconstruction rather than a recorded form.
items.cn: mederi 意为「治愈、照料」。其更深来源不确定；常为它提出的词根是重构，而非有记录的形式。

items.en: Re- 'again' plus mederi produced remedium 'a cure', and English remediation was formed on that base.
items.cn: re-「再」加 mederi 构成 remedium「治疗之物」，英语 remediation 就在这个词基上形成。

items.en: Environmental and remediation were joined in late twentieth-century law and engineering, when contaminated sites had to be assessed and cleaned before reuse.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期，当受污染场地必须评估、清理后才能再使用时，environmental 与 remediation 在法律与工程写作中连用。

items.en: Source uncertain (origin of virer, deeper origin of mederi, first date of the compound): the turning word behind environ is unsettled, the healing root behind mederi is unsettled, and the phrase has no fixed earliest citation, so its first date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（virer 的来源、mederi 的更深来源、该短语的首见年代）：environ 背后「转」的词无定论，mederi 背后「治愈」的词根无定论，这个短语也没有固定的最早书证，首见年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds environmental phrases that look alike and name a neighbouring stage or a false relative; group two holds method names that are often used as if they were synonyms of the whole.
note.cn: 第一组是同含 environmental、外形相近，却指相邻阶段或假同源的短语；第二组是常被当作整体同义词使用的方法名称。

entries.definition: Returning a site to its earlier condition; remediation targets safety, while restoration targets resemblance to the past.
entries.definitionCN: 把场地恢复到较早的状态；remediation 以安全为目标，restoration 以「像过去」为目标。

entries.definition: Reducing the severity of an impact, often before or during a project; it does not necessarily remove the pollutant.
entries.definitionCN: 降低影响的程度，常在项目之前或进行中实施；它未必去除污染物。

entries.definition: Bringing spoiled land into use again, as after mining; it stresses the new use rather than the cleanup standard.
entries.definitionCN: 把废弃土地重新变得可用，如采矿之后；它强调新用途，而非清理标准。

entries.definition: Negotiation between parties over an environmental dispute, from medius 'middle'; it shares spelling with remediation but not root.
entries.definitionCN: 各方就环境争端进行的谈判，出自 medius「中间」；它与 remediation 拼写相近，但词根不同。

entries.definition: Cleanup that uses living organisms to break down contaminants; it is one technique within environmental remediation.
entries.definitionCN: 利用活生物分解污染物的清理；它是环境修复中的一种技术。

entries.definition: Cleanup using plants that absorb or degrade pollutants; a narrower method name.
entries.definitionCN: 利用吸收或降解污染物的植物进行清理；是更窄的方法名称。

entries.definition: The everyday term for removing pollution; the phrase is its formal, regulated version.
entries.definitionCN: 去除污染的日常说法；本短语是其正式、受监管的版本。

entries.definition: Rebuilding on previously used industrial land; it is what often happens after remediation is complete.
entries.definitionCN: 在曾用于工业的土地上重建；它常是修复完成之后发生的事。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Environment is 'surroundings'; remediation is 'curing again'; together they mean curing the place around us.
normal.cn: environment 是「周围」，remediation 是「再治愈」；合起来就是「把我们所在的地方治好」。

normal.en: The family runs remediation, remediate, remedy, remedial and remediable.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 remediation、remediate、remedy、remedial 与 remediable。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: environmental remediation project, costs, technology, standard.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：环境修复项目、费用、技术、标准。

normal.en: Environmental mediation is a false relative: it comes from medius 'middle', not from mederi 'heal'.
normal.cn: environmental mediation 是假同源：它出自 medius「中间」，而非 mederi「治愈」。

normal.en: The work usually ends with reuse: a brownfield becomes a park, a warehouse or housing.
normal.cn: 这项工作通常以再利用收尾：棕地变成公园、仓库或住宅。

abstract.en: Picture a dark mound of soil sealed under a plastic sheet, waiting to be made harmless.
abstract.cn: 想象一座深色土丘被塑料膜封住，等着被变得无害。

abstract.en: Picture a scar on the land filled in and planted over.
abstract.cn: 想象大地上的一道伤疤被填平并种上草木。

abstract.en: Picture a room cleared of everything broken so that people can work in it again.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋子清走所有坏掉的东西，让人们能重新在里面工作。

examples.en: Environmental remediation standards differ from state to state.
examples.cn: 各州的环境修复标准并不相同。

examples.en: The company set aside funds for environmental remediation.
examples.cn: 公司为环境修复预留了资金。

examples.en: Environmental remediation can take longer than the factory ever operated.
examples.cn: 环境修复的时间可能比这家工厂运转的时间还长。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「environmental（环境的）+ remediation（修复）」——给环境治伤 → 环境修复

root: 英语复合短语：environment 经古法语 environ「周围」出自 en- + viron「环行」，viron 出自 virer「转」而来源不确定；remediation 出自拉丁 remedium「治疗之物」= re-（再）+ mederi「治愈」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one repair job: a site is harmed, a plan is made, soil and water are treated, beds are dredged, law certifies the result, habitat is replanted, the site is reused, and finally any surroundings can be mended.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一项修复工程展开：场地受损，方案制定，土壤与水被处理，底泥被疏浚，法律验收，栖息地被重新种植，场地被再利用，最后任何周边都能被修补。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dark soil heaped under a liner while an excavator works an old factory yard.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧厂院里挖掘机作业，深色土壤堆在防渗膜下。

branches.en: THE CORE JOB: the general definition and the soil and water cases share one plan and one standard.
branches.cn: 核心工作：总定义与土壤、地下水情形共享一套方案与一套标准。

branches.en: BEDS: sediment needs dredging or capping because it cannot be pumped like water.
branches.cn: 底泥：沉积物不能像水一样抽走，因此需要疏浚或覆盖。

branches.en: LIABILITY AND CLOSURE: law orders the work, and an ending industry leaves it behind.
branches.cn: 责任与关停：法律下令做这件事，而结束的工业把它留下。

branches.en: LIVING SYSTEM: replanting and reconnecting a habitat goes beyond a chemical threshold.
branches.cn: 生命系统：重新种植与打通通道，超越了化学阈值。

branches.en: TRANSFER: a workplace can be repaired the way a river is.
branches.cn: 转移：工作场所也能像河流一样被修复。

intro.en: The phrase joins an adjective of surroundings to a Latin-derived noun of curing, each built from recognizable parts.
intro.cn: 这个短语把「周围」的形容词连到拉丁来源的「治愈」名词上，两边都由可辨识的成分构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin mederi gives remedy, remediation and remediate; Latin medius gives mediate and mediation; the two roots are different.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 mederi 衍生 remedy、remediation 与 remediate；拉丁 medius 衍生 mediate 与 mediation；两个词根不同。

items.example: The hedges environ the field.
items.exampleCN: 树篱环绕着田地。

items.example: Environmental law governs the cleanup.
items.exampleCN: 环境法管辖这项清理。

items.example: The prefix marks repeated treatment.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出反复处理。

items.example: The root carries the medical image.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着医学意象。

items.example: The suffix names the treatment as a process.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把治疗命名为一个过程。

items.meaning: the act of curing or correcting
items.example: Remediation followed the spill.
items.exampleCN: 泄漏之后进行了修复。

items.example: They remediated the yard.
items.exampleCN: 他们整治了这个院子。

items.example: The remedy was a new drainage ditch.
items.exampleCN: 补救办法是修一条新排水沟。

items.example: Bioremediation used microbes on the oil.
items.exampleCN: 生物修复用微生物处理油污。

items.example: The environmental-remediation budget was approved.
items.exampleCN: 环境修复预算获得批准。

latinEntries.structure: medius, media, medium (adjective, first and second declension)

definition_zh: 有毒的；毒性的；由毒物引起的；比喻有害的
definition_en: poisonous to living organisms, or harmful in a way compared to poison
core_image: 水边一只死鸟旁，黑色油泥泛着彩光，沾在手套上久久不散
scene: 志愿者在水边捡起一只死鸟，手套上沾着发亮的黑色油泥。The spill left a toxic residue along the shoreline.
sceneCN: 这里 toxic 指「对生物有毒的、能造成伤害的」（第 1 个义项：物质对活体生物具有毒性）；句意为泄漏在岸线上留下一层有毒残留物。图中可辨识物件：死鸟、黑色油泥、手套、岸线。

senses.title: Poisonous to living organisms
senses.titleCN: 对生物有毒的
senses.definition: capable of harming or killing an organism by chemical action
senses.definitionCN: 能通过化学作用伤害或杀死生物的
senses.example: The spill left a toxic residue along the shoreline.
senses.exampleCN: 泄漏在岸线上留下一层有毒残留物。
senses.why: The word began as the adjective of Greek toxikon, the poison smeared on arrows, so its core image is a substance that kills at a distance.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是希腊 toxikon 的形容词，指涂在箭上的毒，因此核心意象是「能在远处致死的物质」。

senses.title: Caused by poison, as a medical condition
senses.titleCN: 医学上由毒物引起的
senses.definition: describing an illness, dose or effect produced by a poison or drug
senses.definitionCN: 描述由毒物或药物引起的疾病、剂量或效应
senses.example: The patient showed a toxic reaction to the drug.
senses.exampleCN: 病人对该药出现了毒性反应。
senses.why: Medicine needed an adjective for harm caused by a substance, as distinct from harm caused by infection or injury.
senses.whyCN: 医学需要一个形容词来指「由物质造成的伤害」，以区别于感染或外伤造成的伤害。

senses.title: Chemically hazardous in industry
senses.titleCN: 工业上的化学危险性
senses.definition: describing waste, gas or material that must be handled under special safety rules
senses.definitionCN: 描述必须在专门安全规则下处理的废物、气体或材料
senses.example: Toxic waste must be stored away from the water table.
senses.exampleCN: 有毒废物必须远离地下水位存放。
senses.why: Regulation turned the adjective into a label that triggers permits, protective gear and disposal rules.
senses.whyCN: 监管把这个形容词变成一个标签，一贴上就触发许可、防护装备与处置规则。

senses.title: Produced by a living organism
senses.titleCN: 由生物产生的毒性
senses.definition: describing a poison made by a plant, animal or microbe, as in a toxic secretion
senses.definitionCN: 描述由植物、动物或微生物制造的毒物，如毒性分泌物
senses.example: The frog's skin carries a toxic secretion.
senses.exampleCN: 这只蛙的皮肤带有毒性分泌物。
senses.why: Biology separates what is made by life from what is made in a factory, though both are called toxic.
senses.whyCN: 生物学要区分「生命制造的」与「工厂制造的」，尽管两者都叫 toxic。

senses.title: Harmful to a person's mind or relationships
senses.titleCN: 对人的心理或关系有害的
senses.definition: describing behaviour, a relationship or an atmosphere that damages people psychologically
senses.definitionCN: 描述在心理上伤害人的行为、关系或氛围
senses.example: She left a toxic working environment.
senses.exampleCN: 她离开了一个有害的工作环境。
senses.why: The metaphor works because the harm is slow, cumulative and hard to see, like exposure to a poison.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻成立，是因为伤害缓慢、累积且难以看见，像接触毒物一样。

senses.title: Worthless and dangerous financial assets
senses.titleCN: 金融上的「有毒」资产
senses.definition: describing loans or securities whose value has collapsed and which threaten the holder
senses.definitionCN: 描述价值已崩塌、并危及持有者的贷款或证券
senses.example: The bank was left holding toxic assets.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行最后手里握着有毒资产。
senses.why: Finance borrowed the word because the asset poisons the balance sheet it sits on.
senses.whyCN: 金融界借用这个词，因为这类资产会毒害它所在的资产负债表。

senses.title: Slang: extremely bad or unpleasant
senses.titleCN: 口语：极糟的、令人难受的
senses.definition: an informal use meaning very bad, offensive or unbearable
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用法，指很糟、令人反感或难以忍受
senses.example: The traffic was toxic all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 整个下午的交通都糟透了。
senses.why: Slang strips the word down to pure intensity, keeping the sense of harm without any chemistry.
senses.whyCN: 口语把这个词剥离成纯粹的强度，只留「有害」的感觉，不带任何化学含义。

senses.title: Listed as toxic by regulation
senses.titleCN: 被法规列为有毒的
senses.definition: formally classified as a hazardous substance with a defined threshold and reporting duty
senses.definitionCN: 被正式归为危险物质，附有明确阈值与申报义务
senses.example: The solvent is toxic under the clean-air rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这种溶剂在清洁空气法规下被列为有毒。
senses.why: A legal label is a separate sense because the classification does not depend on how the substance behaves in each case.
senses.whyCN: 法律标签之所以是独立义项，是因为归类并不取决于该物质在每种情形下的实际表现。

senses.title: Abstract: corrosive to a group or culture
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：对群体或文化起腐蚀作用
senses.definition: describing norms, speech or incentives that slowly damage trust and cooperation
senses.definitionCN: 描述缓慢损害信任与合作的规范、言论或激励机制
senses.example: The report called the incentives toxic for new staff.
senses.exampleCN: 报告称这些激励机制对新员工有害。
senses.why: The final extension keeps the medical shape: a small repeated exposure produces a systemic illness.
senses.whyCN: 最后的延伸保留了医学形态：少量而反复的接触会造成全身性的病症。

intro.en: Toxic came to English through Latin from Greek, where the original poison was the one put on arrows. The figurative senses are modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: toxic 经拉丁语从希腊语进入英语，原本的毒是涂在箭上的那种。比喻义是近代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Toxon meant 'bow'. Its own origin is uncertain; it is often treated as a borrowing from a non-Greek language, so any older form offered for it is a hypothesis rather than a proved source.
items.cn: toxon 意为「弓」。它本身的来源不确定；常被看作借自某种非希腊语，因此凡为它给出的更早形式都是假说，而非已证实的来源。

items.en: Toxikon (pharmakon) meant 'arrow poison', literally the thing of the bow; the adjective toxikos described what belonged to the bow or to its poison.
items.cn: toxikon（pharmakon）意为「箭毒」，字面是「属于弓的东西」；形容词 toxikos 描述属于弓或其毒物者。

items.en: Latin toxicum meant 'poison', and toxicus was its adjective; medieval and early modern writers used both for venoms and drugs.
items.cn: 拉丁 toxicum 意为「毒」，toxicus 是其形容词；中世纪与近代早期作者用两者兼指毒液与药物。

items.en: English toxic appears in the seventeenth century as a learned adjective meaning 'poisonous', alongside the noun toxicum.
items.cn: 英语 toxic 在十七世纪作为学术形容词出现，意为「有毒的」，同时还有名词 toxicum。

items.en: Toxicology and industrial hygiene made toxic a standard term for chemical harm, and twentieth-century law turned it into a regulatory category.
items.cn: 毒理学与工业卫生使 toxic 成为化学危害的标准术语，二十世纪的法律又把它变成监管类别。

items.en: Source uncertain (origin of toxon, first date of the figurative senses): the bow word may be a foreign borrowing whose source is unknown, and no single earliest citation is fixed for the relational or slang senses, so their dates are approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（toxon 的来源、比喻义的首见年代）：「弓」这个词可能是外来借词，而借自何处不明；关系义与口语义也没有公认的最早书证，年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same poison stock that differ in part of speech or in sense; group two holds adjectives of harm, each with its own route of injury.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「毒」词干、词性或含义不同的词；第二组是表示「有害」的形容词，各自的伤害路径不同。

entries.definition: A poison made by a living organism, such as a bacterial toxin; toxic is the adjective describing such a substance or its effect.
entries.definitionCN: 由活生物制造的毒物，如细菌毒素；toxic 是描述这种物质或其效应的形容词。

entries.definition: The study of poisons and their effects; it is a discipline name, not a description of a substance.
entries.definitionCN: 研究毒物及其效应的学科；它是学科名称，而非物质描述。

entries.definition: To make drunk or wildly excited, from the same toxicum; the modern sense has left poison behind.
entries.definitionCN: 使醉或使极度兴奋，同出 toxicum；现代义已离开了「毒」的意思。

entries.definition: A condition in which toxins are present in the blood; it names the medical state rather than the property.
entries.definitionCN: 毒素存在于血液中的状况；它命名的是医学状态，而非性质。

entries.definition: Able to harm when eaten, drunk or touched; it is the everyday word, while toxic is the technical and figurative one.
entries.definitionCN: 吃下、喝下或接触时能造成伤害；它是日常词，而 toxic 更技术化、也更多比喻用法。

entries.tag: injected by a bite or sting
entries.definition: Able to inject poison through a bite or sting; a venomous animal is not simply toxic, because the delivery matters.
entries.definitionCN: 能通过咬或蜇注入毒液；venomous 的动物不能简单说成 toxic，因为「如何送入」很关键。

entries.definition: Harmful, especially to health or to the senses, as of fumes; it stresses the unpleasant exposure rather than the chemistry.
entries.definitionCN: 有害的，尤指对健康或感官，如烟气；它强调难受的接触，而非化学性质。

entries.definition: Extremely infectious or severe, used of pathogens and, figuratively, of hostility; it is about spreading power, not poison.
entries.definitionCN: 传染性极强或极严重的，用于病原体，也比喻敌意；它讲的是传播力，而非毒性。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root is Greek toxon 'bow': the first toxic thing was arrow poison.
normal.cn: 词根是希腊 toxon「弓」：最早的「有毒之物」是箭毒。

normal.en: The family runs toxin, toxicity, toxicology, toxicologist and detoxify.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 toxin、toxicity、toxicology、toxicologist 与 detoxify。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: toxic waste, toxic substance, toxic effect, highly toxic.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：有毒废物、有毒物质、毒性效应、剧毒的。

normal.en: Toxic is the adjective; toxin is the substance; toxicity is the degree.
normal.cn: toxic 是形容词；toxin 是物质；toxicity 是程度。

normal.en: Venomous means injected by bite or sting, which is narrower than toxic.
normal.cn: venomous 指经咬或蜇注入，比 toxic 窄。

abstract.en: Picture a drop of poison that takes hours to show its work.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴毒物要过几个小时才显出作用。

abstract.en: Picture a room where every conversation leaves you a little more tired.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋子，每次谈话都让你更疲惫一点。

abstract.en: Picture a loan on a ledger that quietly poisons every page around it.
abstract.cn: 想象账本上的一笔贷款，悄悄毒害周围每一页。

examples.en: The compound is toxic to fish at very low concentrations.
examples.cn: 这种化合物在极低浓度下就对鱼类有毒。

examples.en: Workers handling toxic waste wear sealed suits.
examples.cn: 处理有毒废物的工人穿着密封防护服。

examples.en: The label toxic is also used for relationships and cultures.
examples.cn: toxic 这个标签也被用于关系和职场文化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「tox（弓/箭）+ ic」——涂在箭上的那种东西 → 有毒的

root: 拉丁 toxicus < toxicum「毒」< 希腊 toxikon（pharmakon）「箭毒」< toxon「弓」；toxon 的来源不确定，可能借自非希腊语。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one poison: the substance, the dose, the body, the damage, the label, and then relationships, money, slang and culture borrow the same shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一种毒展开：物质、剂量、身体、损害、标签，随后关系、金钱、口语与文化都借用了同一形态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arrow poison, a substance that kills from a distance.
core.cn: 核心意象：箭毒，一种能在远处致死的物质。

branches.en: BODY: the property of poison and the medical reaction are the same harm seen from outside and inside.
branches.cn: 身体：毒的性质与医学反应，是同一伤害从外面与里面看到的样子。

branches.en: LABEL: industrial handling and legal classification both turn toxicity into a rule.
branches.cn: 标签：工业处置与法律归类都把毒性变成一条规则。

branches.en: LIFE-MADE: a secretion from a plant or animal is poison with a maker.
branches.cn: 生物制造：植物或动物的分泌物，是有制造者的毒。

branches.en: SOCIAL AND FINANCIAL: a relationship and a bad loan both poison what contains them.
branches.cn: 社会与金融：一段关系与一笔坏账，都会毒害容纳它们的东西。

branches.en: INTENSITY: slang keeps only the harm, and culture keeps the slow cumulative exposure.
branches.cn: 强度：口语只留下「有害」，文化义保留「缓慢累积的接触」。

intro.en: Toxic is a Greek-derived adjective with a root that reaches back to the bow and a suffix that makes a quality.
intro.cn: toxic 是希腊来源形容词，词根可追到「弓」，后缀则构成性质形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin toxicum gives toxic, toxin, toxicity, toxicology and intoxicate; Greek toxon 'bow' is the root behind all of them.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 toxicum 衍生 toxic、toxin、toxicity、toxicology 与 intoxicate；希腊 toxon「弓」是它们共同的根。

items.example: The adjective entered English as toxic.

items.example: The suffix makes a quality adjective.

items.example: The bacterium released a toxin.

items.exampleCN: 他们测定了样本的毒性。

items.example: Toxicology screened the water.
items.exampleCN: 毒理学对水做了筛查。

items.exampleCN: 肝脏为血液解毒。

items.exampleCN: 这酒很快让他醉了。

definition_zh: 毒性；毒力；有毒的程度；有害性
definition_en: the quality or degree to which a substance, treatment or condition can harm a living organism
core_image: 一排培养皿里，水蚤在不同浓度的药液中依次停止游动
scene: 实验台上，一排培养皿里的水蚤在不同浓度药液下依次停止游动。The lab measured the toxicity of the runoff at several dilutions.
sceneCN: 这里 toxicity 指「受试物质对生物造成伤害的程度」（第 2 个义项：以不同剂量测得的毒性强度）；句意为实验室在几个稀释倍数下测定了径流的毒性。图中可辨识物件：培养皿、水蚤、不同浓度药液、记录表。

pos.zh: 毒性；毒力（不可数为主，复数指多种或不同程度的毒性）

forms.label: 复数（多种或不同程度的毒性）

senses.title: The quality of being poisonous
senses.titleCN: 有毒这一性质
senses.definition: the property by which a substance can harm or kill a living organism
senses.definitionCN: 某物质能够伤害或杀死生物的性质
senses.example: The lab measured the toxicity of the runoff at several dilutions.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室在几个稀释倍数下测定了径流的毒性。
senses.why: Toxicity is toxic plus -ity, the suffix of a state, so it names the state of being poisonous rather than the poison itself.
senses.whyCN: toxicity 是 toxic 加 -ity（状态后缀），因此命名的是「有毒这一状态」，而不是毒物本身。

senses.title: A measured degree in toxicology
senses.titleCN: 毒理学中可测量的强度
senses.definition: the numerical relation between a dose and the response it produces, such as the dose that kills half a test population
senses.definitionCN: 剂量与其引起的反应之间的数值关系，如使半数受试生物死亡的剂量
senses.example: The pesticide's toxicity was expressed in milligrams per kilogram.
senses.exampleCN: 这种农药的毒性以每千克体重毫克数表示。
senses.why: Toxicology made the word quantitative: every poison has a dose, and the degree of harm is a curve rather than a yes or no.
senses.whyCN: 毒理学使这个词量化：任何毒物都有剂量，伤害程度是一条曲线，而不是「是或否」。

senses.title: Acute versus chronic toxicity
senses.titleCN: 急性与慢性毒性之分
senses.definition: the classification of harm by whether it follows one large exposure or repeated small ones over time
senses.definitionCN: 按伤害来自一次大剂量接触还是长期反复小剂量接触所作的分类
senses.example: Chronic toxicity appeared only after months of exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 慢性毒性在接触数月之后才显现。
senses.why: Duration changes the harm entirely, so the word is routinely split into two named kinds.
senses.whyCN: 持续时间会彻底改变危害，因此这个词常被分成两个具名的类别。

senses.title: Harm caused by a medical treatment
senses.titleCN: 治疗本身造成的毒性
senses.definition: the damaging side effect of a drug, radiation or procedure at therapeutic doses
senses.definitionCN: 药物、放射或操作在治疗剂量下产生的损害性副作用
senses.example: The regimen was reduced because of liver toxicity.
senses.exampleCN: 由于肝脏毒性，这套方案被减量。
senses.why: Medicine needed a word for harm that comes from the cure itself, not from the disease.
senses.whyCN: 医学需要一个词来指「治疗本身带来的伤害」，而非疾病带来的伤害。

senses.title: Ecological toxicity
senses.titleCN: 生态毒性
senses.definition: the harm a substance does to fish, insects, plants or soil organisms in the environment
senses.definitionCN: 某物质对环境中的鱼、昆虫、植物或土壤生物造成的伤害
senses.example: Aquatic toxicity testing uses fish, daphnia and algae.
senses.exampleCN: 水生毒性试验使用鱼、水蚤与藻类。
senses.why: Ecology asks not only whether a substance harms people but whether it harms the organisms that hold a system together.
senses.whyCN: 生态学不只问某物质是否害人，还问它是否危害维持系统运转的生物。

senses.title: A regulatory hazard class
senses.titleCN: 监管上的危险类别
senses.definition: a formal category assigned to a chemical according to the harm it can cause
senses.definitionCN: 按可能造成的危害给化学品正式指定的类别
senses.example: The label warns of reproductive toxicity.
senses.exampleCN: 标签警示具有生殖毒性。
senses.why: Regulation turns the measured property into a class, so a substance can carry a toxicity label before any incident occurs.
senses.whyCN: 监管把测得的性质变成类别，因此某物质在事故发生之前就可以带上毒性标签。

senses.title: The potency of a toxin or venom
senses.titleCN: 毒素或毒液的毒力
senses.definition: the strength of a poison produced by an organism, measured by how little is needed to cause harm
senses.definitionCN: 生物所产毒物的强度，以造成伤害所需的最小量来衡量
senses.example: The venom's toxicity varied between populations.
senses.exampleCN: 不同种群之间，这种毒液的毒性并不相同。
senses.why: Here the word measures a biological product, where small differences decide whether a bite is merely painful or fatal.
senses.whyCN: 这里衡量的是生物产物，微小的差别决定一次咬伤是疼痛还是致命。

senses.title: Social toxicity in online or group settings
senses.titleCN: 网络与群体中的社会性有害氛围
senses.definition: the degree to which a community, forum or conversation is abusive, hostile or emotionally damaging
senses.definitionCN: 一个社群、论坛或对话充满辱骂、敌意或情感伤害的程度
senses.example: Moderators scored the thread's toxicity before deleting it.
senses.exampleCN: 版主在删除这条帖子前给它评了有害程度。
senses.why: Platforms needed a measurable word for the harm done by words, and toxicity supplied a scale.
senses.whyCN: 平台需要一个可衡量的词来指「言语造成的伤害」，toxicity 提供了尺度。

senses.title: Abstract: systemic harm in an institution
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：制度内部的系统性毒害
senses.definition: a transferred use for the cumulative damage that norms, incentives or habits do to trust and health
senses.definitionCN: 转指规范、激励或习惯对信任与健康造成的累积损害
senses.example: The audit described the toxicity of the promotion system.
senses.exampleCN: 审计报告描述了晋升制度的毒害性。
senses.why: The medical frame survives: repeated small exposures, not one incident, produce the illness.
senses.whyCN: 医学框架仍然保留：致病的是反复的小剂量接触，而非单一事件。

intro.en: Toxicity is toxic plus the Latin state suffix -ity. The root goes back through Latin to Greek arrow poison. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: toxicity 是 toxic 加拉丁状态后缀 -ity。词根经拉丁语可追到希腊的箭毒。年代均为约数。

items.en: Toxon meant 'bow'. Its origin is uncertain and it may be a borrowing from a non-Greek language, so any older form offered for it is a hypothesis.
items.cn: toxon 意为「弓」。其来源不确定，可能是借自某种非希腊语，因此凡为它给出的更早形式都属假说。

items.en: Toxikon (pharmakon) meant 'arrow poison', literally the thing belonging to the bow; its adjective toxikos gave Latin toxicus.
items.cn: toxikon（pharmakon）意为「箭毒」，字面是「属于弓的东西」；其形容词 toxikos 给出拉丁 toxicus。

items.en: Latin toxicum meant 'poison', and medieval Latin used it for both venoms and drugs.
items.cn: 拉丁 toxicum 意为「毒」，中世纪拉丁用它兼指毒液与药物。

items.en: English toxic appears in the seventeenth century as a learned adjective meaning 'poisonous'.
items.cn: 英语 toxic 在十七世纪作为学术形容词出现，意为「有毒的」。

items.en: The noun toxicity and the discipline of toxicology grew with nineteenth-century chemistry and medicine, when poisons had to be measured rather than merely named.
items.cn: 名词 toxicity 与毒理学随着十九世纪的化学与医学成长，因为毒物需要被测量，而不只是被命名。

items.en: Source uncertain (origin of toxon, first date of the noun): the bow word may be a foreign borrowing whose source is unknown, and no single earliest citation is fixed for toxicity, so its first date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（toxon 的来源、该名词的首见年代）：「弓」这个词可能是来源不明的外来借词，toxicity 也没有公认的最早书证，首见年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same poison family that are easily confused with the abstract noun; group two holds measures and states that are often substituted for toxicity.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「毒」词族、容易与本抽象名词混淆的形式；第二组是常被用来替换 toxicity 的度量与状态词。

entries.definition: Poisonous; it describes the property, while toxicity names the property as a measurable thing.
entries.definitionCN: 有毒的；它描述性质，而 toxicity 把这一性质作为可测量之物命名。

entries.definition: A poison made by an organism; a toxin has toxicity, but the two words answer different questions.
entries.definitionCN: 生物制造的毒物；毒素具有毒性，但这两个词回答的是不同问题。

entries.definition: A condition caused by poisoning; it is the illness, not the property that caused it.
entries.definitionCN: 由中毒引起的病况；它是疾病，而非造成疾病的性质。

entries.definition: The presence of toxins in the blood; a clinical finding rather than a measure of poisonousness.
entries.definitionCN: 毒素存在于血液中；它是临床发现，而非毒性的度量。

entries.definition: The degree of damage a pathogen causes in a host; it is a property of the organism, not of a chemical.
entries.definitionCN: 病原体对宿主造成损害的程度；它是生物的属性，而非化学物质的属性。

entries.definition: The strength of a drug or poison at a given amount; toxicity is the harm it does, potency is how little is needed.
entries.definitionCN: 一定量药物或毒物的强度；toxicity 是造成的伤害，potency 是需要多少才起效。

entries.definition: The capacity to cause death, often expressed as a proportion; toxicity also covers non-fatal harm.
entries.definitionCN: 致死的能力，常以比例表示；toxicity 还涵盖非致死的伤害。

entries.definition: A source of possible harm; toxicity is one property that makes something hazardous.
entries.definitionCN: 可能造成伤害的来源；毒性是使某物成为危险源的一种性质。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Toxicity is toxic plus -ity, the suffix of a state: the state of being poisonous.
normal.cn: toxicity 是 toxic 加 -ity（状态后缀）：有毒这一状态。

normal.en: The root is Greek toxon 'bow', the poison first used on arrows.
normal.cn: 词根是希腊 toxon「弓」，最早用在箭上的毒。

normal.en: The family runs toxic, toxin, toxicology, toxicological and toxicosis.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 toxic、toxin、toxicology、toxicological 与 toxicosis。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: acute toxicity, chronic toxicity, toxicity test, toxicity level.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：急性毒性、慢性毒性、毒性试验、毒性水平。

normal.en: The two collocations acute and chronic split the word by duration.
normal.cn: acute 与 chronic 两个搭配按持续时间把这个词一分为二。

abstract.en: Picture daphnia stopping one by one as the dilution gets stronger.
abstract.cn: 想象随着稀释变淡又变浓，水蚤一只只停止游动。

abstract.en: Picture a medicine that cures one organ and slowly harms another.
abstract.cn: 想象一种药治好一个器官，却慢慢伤害另一个。

abstract.en: Picture a comment section where every reply makes the next one harsher.
abstract.cn: 想象一个评论区，每条回复都让下一条更刻薄。

examples.en: Toxicity depends on dose, duration and the organism exposed.
examples.cn: 毒性取决于剂量、持续时间与受试生物。

examples.en: The label lists acute toxicity and long-term effects.
examples.cn: 标签列出急性毒性与长期效应。

examples.en: Online platforms now measure toxicity in comments.
examples.cn: 网络平台如今会测量评论的有害程度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「toxic（有毒的）+ ity」——有毒的程度 → 毒性

root: toxic + -ity；toxic 经拉丁 toxicus / toxicum「毒」出自希腊 toxikon「箭毒」，再出自 toxon「弓」，toxon 的来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one property and one scale: the poison exists, a dose is given, a response is measured, duration splits it, medicine and ecology apply it, law labels it, and finally words and institutions are scored on the same scale.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一种性质与一把尺子展开：毒物存在，给出剂量，测出反应，时间把它分开，医学与生态各自应用，法律给它贴标签，最后言语与制度也用同一把尺子打分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of daphnia stopping at different dilutions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排水蚤在不同稀释浓度下依次停下。

branches.en: PROPERTY AND NUMBER: the quality and its measured degree are the same thing before and after the instrument.
branches.cn: 性质与数字：这一性质与它的测量值，是仪器前后的同一件事。

branches.en: TIME: one large dose and many small ones produce different illnesses.
branches.cn: 时间：一次大剂量与多次小剂量造成不同的病症。

branches.en: BODY AND ECOSYSTEM: a patient and a pond are both test cases for the same property.
branches.cn: 身体与生态：病人与池塘都是同一性质的受试对象。

branches.en: LABEL AND POTENCY: regulation fixes a class, biology measures how little is needed.
branches.cn: 标签与毒力：监管固定类别，生物学衡量需要多少才起效。

branches.en: TRANSFER: abusive speech and bad incentives are scored as if they were poisons.
branches.cn: 转移：辱骂言语与坏激励被当作毒物来打分。

intro.en: Toxicity is a Greek-Latin root with a Latin state suffix, so it can be read as poison plus degree.
intro.cn: toxicity 是希腊—拉丁词根加拉丁状态后缀，可以读作「毒 + 程度」。

latinIntro.en: Latin toxicum gives toxic, toxin, toxicity, toxicology and intoxicate; the suffix -itas appears in English as -ity in toxicity, rarity and paucity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 toxicum 衍生 toxic、toxin、toxicity、toxicology 与 intoxicate；后缀 -itas 在英语中作 -ity，如 toxicity、rarity 与 paucity。

items.example: The bow gave the poison its name.
items.exampleCN: 弓把名字给了这种毒。

items.example: Toxikon was smeared on the arrowhead.
items.exampleCN: toxikon 被涂在箭头上。

items.example: The Latin adjective became English toxic.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁形容词变成了英语 toxic。

items.example: The suffix turns an adjective into a measurable state.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把形容词变成可测量的状态。

items.example: The water was toxic to fish.
items.exampleCN: 这水对鱼有毒。

items.example: Toxicity rose with concentration.
items.exampleCN: 毒性随浓度上升。

items.example: The mould produced a toxin.
items.exampleCN: 这种霉菌产生一种毒素。

items.example: Toxicology set the safety limit.
items.exampleCN: 毒理学设定了安全限值。

items.example: Toxicosis followed the contaminated feed.
items.exampleCN: 受污染的饲料导致了中毒症。

items.example: The filter detoxifies the water.
items.exampleCN: 过滤器为水去毒。
